Skiddo was gentle and friendly, and it loved to give rides. The little children climbed onto its back, and Skiddo walked slowly around the meadow. Clip, clop, clip, clop. "Faster, Skiddo!" they giggled. So Skiddo trotted a little faster, and the children held on tight, laughing in the sunshine.

Gogoat was a big goat Pokémon with curly horns and leaves on its back. People in the mountains rode on Gogoat to get around, and it could feel exactly how its rider was feeling, through its horns.

When its rider was happy, Gogoat trotted happily. When its rider was tired, Gogoat walked slowly and gently. When its rider was scared, Gogoat stopped and waited until they felt brave again. "Gogoat always knows," said the mountain children. And they held its horns and rode all the way home.

Pancham was a little panda Pokémon with a leaf in its mouth. It tried very hard to look tough and scary, but it was much too cute!

Pancham scowled at a Pidove. The Pidove giggled. Pancham stomped its foot at a Bunnelby. The Bunnelby giggled. Pancham crossed its arms and made its fiercest face at a little girl. She giggled the most of all. "You're so cute!" she said, and gave it a big hug. Pancham stopped scowling. Being cute wasn't so bad after all.

Pangoro was a big, strong panda Pokémon with a leaf in its mouth. It was the leader of all the Pancham, and it took good care of them.

Pangoro looked tough, but it had a soft heart. When the little Pancham got into trouble, Pangoro helped them out. When they were sad, it gave them big panda hugs. And when they tried to look tough like Pangoro, Pangoro smiled. "Being strong isn't about looking scary," it said. "It's about looking after your friends."

Furfrou was a fluffy poodle Pokémon, and its fur could be trimmed into all sorts of fancy styles. Hearts! Stars! Diamonds! Long ago, it guarded kings and queens.

Furfrou loved going to the groomer. Snip, snip, snip! It came out with a new style every time. One week it had heart-shaped fur. The next week it had star-shaped fur. The children waited outside the shop every Saturday to see. "What style will it be today?" And Furfrou trotted out, proud as a king, showing off its newest look.

Espurr was a little gray kitten Pokémon with huge eyes. It had so much psychic power that it kept its ears folded down, to keep its power from escaping.

Espurr didn't say much. It just looked at you with its big, round eyes. Blink. Blink. The children in town thought it was the cutest Pokémon ever. "What are you thinking, Espurr?" they asked. Espurr blinked again. Nobody knew what it was thinking. But it always seemed to be thinking very happy thoughts.

Meowstic was a cat Pokémon with folded ears. When it opened its ears, a special pattern inside them sent out powerful psychic energy.

Meowstic used its power to protect its friends. When a family's little boy got lost in a crowd, Meowstic opened its ears and felt for him. There! It found him by the fountain, holding a balloon. Meowstic led his family right to him, and they hugged him tight. Meowstic folded its ears back down and purred happily.

Honedge was a ghost Pokémon that looked like an old sword with a long blue ribbon. It floated in the air, quietly, and it didn't like being picked up by strangers.

Honedge had been floating in an old castle for a very long time. It was lonely. One day, a little Pikachu came exploring. "Hello," said Pikachu. "Want to be friends?" Honedge wiggled its ribbon. Nobody had asked it that before. They played hide-and-seek in the old castle halls all afternoon, and Honedge wasn't lonely anymore.

Doublade was two ghost swords floating together, side by side. They were twins, and they did everything together.

The two swords spun around each other in the air, like dancers. Twirl, twirl, swish! When one moved left, the other moved left. When one moved right, the other moved right. People said Doublade's dance was the most graceful thing they had ever seen. And at night, the twins floated down and rested side by side, ribbons gently tangled.

Aegislash was a ghost Pokémon with a sword and a shield. Long, long ago, it watched over the kings and queens of a great kingdom, keeping them safe.

Aegislash was very wise and very loyal. It had seen many kings and queens come and go. Now, it lived in the old castle and watched over the town instead. When the town held a festival, Aegislash stood at the castle gate, its shield shining in the sun. The children waved at it. "Hello, guardian!" And Aegislash raised its sword in a salute.

Spritzee was a little pink Pokémon that smelled wonderful. Long ago, fancy ladies and gentlemen carried Spritzee around with them instead of wearing perfume!

Spritzee could make many different smells: roses, honey, fresh rain and even warm cookies. It floated around the town, making everyone smile with its lovely scents. Sniff! "Mmm, cookies!" said a little boy. He looked around for cookies but only found Spritzee, giggling. Spritzee liked to play that trick.

Aromatisse was a fancy pink Pokémon that could make all kinds of lovely smells. It made perfumes so special that they could make you feel happy or calm or brave.

When a little girl was nervous before her first day of school, Aromatisse made a smell like fresh flowers and sunshine. Sniff. The girl took a deep breath. She felt calm and happy. "I can do this," she said. And she walked into school with a big smile, still smelling the sunshine.

Swirlix was a fluffy white Pokémon made of sweet cotton candy. It loved sweets more than anything, and it ate sugar every single day.

Swirlix's fur was sticky and sweet, like cotton candy. When it bumped into things, they stuck to it! A leaf, a feather, a dandelion seed. Swirlix walked around the park covered in little things. "You're a walking collection!" the children laughed. Swirlix licked off a sticky leaf. Hmm. Not as sweet as candy.

Slurpuff was a fluffy, sweet Pokémon with an amazing nose. It could smell the tiniest bit of sugar from far, far away.

Slurpuff worked with a pastry chef in the town bakery. When the chef baked cakes, Slurpuff sniffed them to see if they were ready. Sniff, sniff. "Not yet." Sniff, sniff. "Now!" The chef took out the cakes, and they were perfect every time. The bakery was famous across the land, and Slurpuff got the first slice of every cake.

Inkay was a little squid Pokémon with spots on its body that could flash with light. Flash, flash, flash! It floated in the air, waving its little tentacles.

Inkay liked to flash its lights in pretty patterns. Blink, blink, twinkle! The other Pokémon stopped to watch, and they felt very calm and a little bit sleepy. Inkay's lights were like a bedtime light show. So every evening, the little Pokémon gathered to watch Inkay flash, and one by one, they drifted off to sleep.

Malamar was a squid Pokémon that looked upside down, with its head at the bottom and its tentacles at the top! It had glowing spots that could flash with light.

Malamar was used to seeing things upside down. Trees grew down. Clouds were under its feet. Rain fell up! It thought this was perfectly normal. One day, a little girl stood on her head to see what Malamar saw. "Whoa! The whole world is upside down!" she laughed. Malamar flashed its lights happily. Finally, someone understood.

Binacle was two little Pokémon living on one rock. They each had a head and an arm, and they shared the same rock. They had to work together for everything!

When the two Binacle wanted to move, they both had to walk in the same direction. "Left!" "Right!" Oops! They went in a circle. "Okay, together this time," said one. "Left, right, left, right!" And they walked off down the beach, step by step, the best teamwork on the shore.

Barbaracle was seven Binacle all living on one big rock. Each one had its own head and its own arm, so Barbaracle had seven heads and seven arms!

With seven arms, Barbaracle could do seven things at once. It could build a sandcastle, collect seashells, wave hello, dig a moat, carry water, plant a flag and scratch its head, all at the same time! The children on the beach watched in amazement. "How do you do it?" they asked. "Teamwork," said all seven heads at once.

Skrelp was a little sea Pokémon that looked exactly like a piece of old seaweed. It floated in the water, perfectly still, so nobody would notice it.

Skrelp was great at hiding. When the fish swam by, they thought it was just seaweed. When the children came to the beach, they thought it was just seaweed. But one little boy looked very closely. "Hey, this seaweed has eyes!" Skrelp wiggled and swam away, giggling. It wasn't seaweed at all!

Dragalge was a dragon Pokémon that looked like a long piece of seaweed. It lived in the sea, among the kelp forests, and it watched over its underwater home.

Dragalge's kelp forest was a safe place for the little fish. They swam in and out of the tall seaweed, playing hide-and-seek. Dragalge floated nearby, keeping watch. When a big wave came, Dragalge curled its long body around the little fish to keep them safe. When the wave passed, the fish swam out, and the game went on.

Clauncher was a little blue shrimp Pokémon with one big claw. It could shoot a jet of water from its claw, very fast and very far. Splash!

Clauncher liked to play water games with its friends. It shot water at floating leaves to knock them over. Splash! It shot water at a bell to make it ring. Splash, ding! And on hot days, it shot water at its friends to cool them off. Splash! "Hey!" they laughed, and splashed it right back.

Clawitzer was a blue shrimp Pokémon with a huge claw that was even bigger than its body. Its claw could shoot powerful jets of water across the sea.

When the beach town had a sandcastle contest, Clawitzer helped. It sprayed careful little jets of water to make the sand just right for building. Splash, splash! The castles were taller and stronger than ever before. And when the contest was over, Clawitzer shot one big jet of water into the sky, and a rainbow appeared over the beach.

Helioptile was a little yellow lizard Pokémon with frills on its head. Its frills soaked up sunlight and turned it into electricity. It was like a little solar panel!

Helioptile didn't need to eat very much. It just lay in the sun, soaking up the light. Ahh. When it had enough energy, it scampered around, full of sparks. Zip, zip! Its friends asked to lie in the sun with it. "Teach us to soak up sunshine!" So they all lay down together, and it was the best afternoon nap ever.

When Helioptile touched a Sun Stone, it became Heliolisk, a lizard Pokémon with big frills that could make lots of electricity. When it spread its frills, they sparkled with energy.

Heliolisk lived in the desert, where the sun was strong. It soaked up so much sunshine that it had energy to share. When the desert town's lights went out, Heliolisk spread its frills and sent its electricity into the power lines. Bzzt! The lights came back on. "Thank you, Heliolisk!" said the town. Heliolisk spread its frills proudly.

Tyrunt was an ancient Pokémon from long, long ago. It had big jaws and a bit of a temper. When it didn't get its way, it stomped and grumbled and threw a tantrum!

Tyrunt stomped its feet. "I want that berry!" It grumbled and growled. Its friends waited patiently. When Tyrunt calmed down, it felt a bit silly. "Sorry," it said. "I was just hungry." Its friend shared the berry with it. Tyrunt smiled. Sharing was much better than stomping.

Tyrantrum was a giant ancient Pokémon with huge jaws and a crown of spikes. Long, long ago, it was the king of the ancient world.

Now, Tyrantrum lived in a big park at the museum. It was huge and strong, but it was also very old and very wise. The children came to visit it every weekend. "Tell us about the old days, King Tyrantrum!" Tyrantrum lay down in the grass and told them about giant ferns, ancient volcanoes and its friends from long ago.

Amaura was an ancient Pokémon that lived in cold places long, long ago. It had sails on its head that shimmered with beautiful colors, like the northern lights.

Amaura lived in a special icy room at the museum, where it was always cold. Its sails shimmered pink and green and blue. The children pressed their noses against the glass to watch. "It's like a rainbow in the snow!" they whispered. Amaura liked visitors. It shimmered a little brighter, just for them.

Aurorus was a tall ancient Pokémon with diamond-shaped crystals along its sides. When it was happy, the crystals glowed with all the colors of the northern lights.

At night, Aurorus walked across the snowy fields, and the sky above it filled with ribbons of shimmering light. Green, pink, purple, blue! The people in the snowy town came outside to watch. "Aurorus is out tonight," they whispered. And they watched until the lights faded and Aurorus walked home to sleep.

Sylveon was a pink and white Pokémon with ribbon-like feelers. When Eevee became very close friends with someone, it could grow into Sylveon, one of the gentlest Pokémon of all.

Sylveon used its ribbons to show how it felt. When it was happy, it wrapped its ribbons around its friend's arm, gently, like a hug. When someone was upset, Sylveon sent out a soft, calming feeling through its ribbons. Ahh. Everyone who met Sylveon felt calmer and happier. It was the best friend anyone could have.

Hawlucha was a bird Pokémon with a colorful mask, like a wrestler. It loved to show off its fancy flying moves.

Hawlucha did flips in the air. It did spins. It did loop-the-loops. Whoosh, whirl, ta-da! Every time it landed, it struck a pose and waited for applause. The children always clapped. "Bravo, Hawlucha!" Hawlucha bowed. Then it flew up into the air and did its biggest, fanciest flip of all.

Dedenne was a little orange mouse Pokémon with long whiskers that worked like antennae. It could send messages to its friends far away using its whiskers.

Dedenne liked to play a game with its friends. It sent a message through its whiskers: "Where are you?" Then it waited. Bzzt! "I'm by the river!" came the reply. Dedenne scampered off to find them. When it was tired, it curled up near a lamp and soaked up a little bit of electricity. Ahh, warm and cozy.

Carbink was a little Pokémon made of rock, with a beautiful jewel on its head. It was born deep, deep underground, and it slept for hundreds of years before waking up.

When Carbink finally woke up, it climbed up to the surface and saw the world for the first time. The sun! The sky! The flowers! Everything was so beautiful. Its jewel sparkled in the sunlight. The little Pokémon came to see the shiny new visitor. "Welcome!" they said. Carbink sparkled even brighter.

Goomy was a little purple dragon Pokémon that was all soft and slimy. It was the weakest dragon of all, but it was also one of the cutest.

Goomy's slimy skin had to stay wet, so it loved rainy days. Splish, splash! When the sun came out, it hid in the shade. Its friends sometimes found it a little too slimy to hug. But Goomy didn't mind. It just smiled its gooey smile and waved its antennae. And some friends hugged it anyway, slime and all.

Sliggoo was a slimy dragon Pokémon with a little shell on its back. It moved very slowly, leaving a shiny, slimy trail behind it. Slide, slide, slide.

Sliggoo was patient. It didn't mind being slow. While it slid along, it looked at everything: the flowers, the bugs, the raindrops. "You're so slow!" said a quick Fletchling. "Yes," said Sliggoo. "But I see everything." The Fletchling stopped and looked around. It had never noticed how pretty the flowers were.

Goodra was a big, gooey dragon Pokémon, and it was the friendliest dragon of all. It loved its friends so much that it always wanted to give them big, gooey hugs!

When Goodra saw a friend, it ran over with its arms wide open. "Hug!" Squish! Its friend was covered in slime. "Goodra!" they laughed. Goodra didn't understand why everyone laughed. It just loved hugging. And even though the hugs were slimy, everyone agreed: Goodra gave the warmest, most loving hugs in the world.

Klefki was a little Pokémon that looked like a key ring, and it loved collecting keys. Jingle, jingle, jingle! It carried them on its ring wherever it went.

Klefki collected all kinds of keys: big keys, little keys, shiny keys and old rusty keys. When people lost their keys, they often found them on Klefki's ring! "That's my house key!" said a man. Klefki jingled happily and gave it back. It didn't mind. It had plenty of other keys to play with.

Phantump was a little ghost Pokémon that lived inside an old tree stump. It had a leafy head and a little stump body, and it liked to wander through the forest at night.

Phantump was a bit shy, and it liked quiet places. It walked through the forest, saying good night to the trees. "Good night, oak. Good night, pine." The trees rustled their leaves back. One night, a little Pidove landed on Phantump's head. "Can I sleep here?" it asked. Phantump smiled. Now it had a friend to say good night to.

Trevenant was a big tree Pokémon with a spooky face and long branch arms. It was the guardian of the forest, and it could talk to the trees using its roots.

When someone was lost in the forest, Trevenant asked the trees, "Have you seen anyone?" The trees whispered back through their roots. "Over there, by the stream." So Trevenant went and found them and showed them the way out. "Thank you!" they said. Trevenant just nodded its leafy head and went back to watching over the forest.

Pumpkaboo was a little pumpkin Pokémon with a smiley face. It glowed softly at night, like a little pumpkin lantern.

Pumpkaboo loved autumn evenings, when the leaves were falling and the air was crisp. It hopped through the pumpkin patch, glowing softly, saying hello to all the other pumpkins. "Hello, pumpkin! Hello, pumpkin!" They didn't say anything back, of course. But Pumpkaboo didn't mind. It liked being the only pumpkin that could hop.

Gourgeist was a pumpkin Pokémon with long, swishy hair. It liked to sing songs at night, especially when the moon was out.

On autumn nights, the Gourgeist gathered in the pumpkin patch and sang together. Ooo, ooo, ahh! Their songs were a little bit spooky but also quite pretty. The children in the farmhouse listened from their beds. "The pumpkins are singing again," they whispered, smiling. And they fell asleep to the Gourgeist's moonlight song.

Bergmite was a little Pokémon made of ice that lived in the snowy mountains. It liked to sit very still, looking like a little ice cube.

Bergmite was so cold that it could freeze the air around it. Brrr! When it got a crack in its body, it simply froze a little more ice to cover it up. When its friends came to visit, Bergmite made little ice sculptures for them. A snowflake! A star! A tiny little Pidove! "Wow, Bergmite!" they said.

Avalugg was a giant Pokémon made of ice, as big and flat as an iceberg. Its back was so wide and flat that lots of little Pokémon could ride on it at once.

The little Bergmite loved to ride on Avalugg's back. They climbed up and sat in a row, and Avalugg walked slowly across the snowy mountain. Thud, thud, thud. "Faster, Avalugg!" So Avalugg slid down a snowy slope like a big sled. Wheeeee! The little ones squealed with joy. It was the best sled ride on the whole mountain.

Noibat was a little bat Pokémon with big ears. It could make loud, squeaky sounds that bounced off the cave walls and helped it find its way in the dark.

Noibat loved fruit, especially ripe, juicy fruit. At night, it flew out of its cave and searched the orchards. Squeak, squeak! Its sounds bounced back and told it where the ripest fruit was. Munch, munch, slurp! By morning, it flew back to its cave with a very full, very happy tummy.

Noivern was a big dragon bat Pokémon with huge ears like speakers. It could make sounds so loud and so powerful that they echoed for miles.

Noivern flew through the dark night sky, using its sounds to see. It never bumped into anything. When the night was very dark, and the little Noibat were scared to fly, Noivern flew beside them, calling out its sounds. "Follow my voice," it said. And the little Noibat followed it through the night, safe and sound.

Xerneas was a legendary Pokémon with beautiful, glowing antlers like the branches of a tree. People said it could share the gift of life with the world.

When Xerneas's antlers glowed in seven colors, the trees grew taller, the flowers bloomed brighter and the forest filled with new life. Long, long ago, Xerneas turned into a tree and fell asleep for a thousand years. People say that if you find a tree with sparkling, rainbow-colored branches, it might be Xerneas, sleeping peacefully.

Yveltal was a legendary Pokémon with great dark wings, shaped like the letter Y. It was very powerful, and it spent most of its time asleep, wrapped up in a cocoon.

Yveltal and Xerneas were opposites. Xerneas brought new beginnings, and Yveltal brought endings, like when autumn leaves fall so spring can come again. People were a bit scared of Yveltal. But the wise old folks knew that both were needed. "Without endings, there can be no new beginnings," they said. And the world stayed in balance.

Zygarde was a legendary Pokémon that watched over all of nature. It was made of lots and lots of tiny green cells, scattered all over the world.

Zygarde's tiny cells hid everywhere: under rocks, in caves, in the roots of trees. They watched and listened, making sure the forests, rivers and mountains were healthy. When nature needed help, the cells gathered together and became Zygarde. Then it set to work, keeping the world green and safe.

Diancie was a Mythical Pokémon, a beautiful princess made of pink diamond. It could make sparkling diamonds just by holding its hands together.

Diancie lived deep underground, in a kingdom of sparkling jewels. It took care of all the Carbink who lived there. When the jewels started to lose their shine, Diancie held its hands together and made new diamonds. Sparkle, sparkle! The whole underground kingdom glittered and shone again, and all the Carbink cheered for their princess.

Hoopa was a mischievous Mythical Pokémon with golden rings. It could send things through its rings to anywhere in the world. Pop!

Hoopa loved to play tricks. It sent a sandcastle from the beach to the top of a mountain. Pop! It sent a snowman from the mountain to the desert. Pop! And it sent a big bunch of balloons from the toy shop to a little girl's birthday party. Pop! "Surprise!" she shouted. The toy shop owner scratched his head. Then Hoopa popped a thank-you note onto his counter, and he laughed.

Volcanion was a Mythical Pokémon with a big arm on its back that could shoot out clouds of steam. It lived high in the mountains, hidden in the mist.

Volcanion was very powerful, but it was also kind. It used its steam to make the mountains misty, so the shy Pokémon living there could hide and stay safe. When a little lost Pokémon wandered into the mist, Volcanion blew a gentle, warm cloud of steam to guide it home. Whoosh! The little one followed the warm cloud all the way back to its family.

Rowlet was a little round owl Pokémon with a leaf bow tie. It could fly so quietly that nobody ever heard it coming. Swoosh, but without the swoosh!

Rowlet liked to sleep during the day, tucked inside the backpack of its best friend, a little boy. Snore, snore. When the boy opened his bag for lunch, there was Rowlet, fast asleep on top of his sandwich. "Rowlet!" he laughed. Rowlet opened one eye, turned its head all the way around and went back to sleep.

Dartrix was an owl Pokémon that cared very much about how it looked. It spent hours every day smoothing its feathers until they were perfectly neat.

Dartrix preened its wings. It fluffed its chest. It straightened its leafy hood. Then it looked at its reflection in the pond. "Perfect," it said. But then the wind blew, and all its feathers went messy. "Oh no!" Dartrix sighed and started preening all over again. Its friends giggled. "You look fine, Dartrix!" But Dartrix kept preening, just in case.

Decidueye was a tall owl Pokémon with a leafy hood, like a cloak. It was calm and quiet, and it could move through the forest without making a sound.

Decidueye watched over the forest from the tallest tree. It saw everything, but it didn't say much. When the little Rowlet were learning to fly, Decidueye showed them how to glide silently. "Soft wings," it whispered. "Quiet as the moon." And the little Rowlet glided through the trees, softly, softly, without a sound.

Litten was a little black and red kitten Pokémon with a fiery spirit. It was very independent and liked to do things on its own.

Litten kept its fur very clean. It licked and licked until every hair was shiny. Lick, lick, lick. And when its old fur fell out, Litten made it into a little ball and puffed a tiny flame at it. Poof! The fur ball burned away in a puff of sparks. Litten looked very pleased with itself. It was the neatest kitten in town.

Torracat was a cat Pokémon with a bell on its neck, and the bell was made of fire! When Torracat was excited, the bell glowed brighter and brighter.

Torracat liked to play chase with its friends. When it ran, its fiery bell went ding, ding, ding! Its friends always knew where it was. "There's Torracat!" they shouted, following the ringing. Torracat was fast, but it always slowed down a little so its friends could catch up. Ding, ding, gotcha!

Incineroar was a big, tough cat Pokémon with a fiery belt around its waist. It looked rough and grumpy, and it liked to pretend it didn't care about anyone.

But Incineroar had a secret: it loved little ones. When the small Pokémon were around, Incineroar always made sure they were safe. When a little Litten got stuck up a tree, Incineroar grumbled, "Ugh, fine," and climbed right up to get it. Then it carried the Litten down and pretended nothing had happened. But everyone saw. Incineroar was a big softie.

Popplio was a little sea lion Pokémon with a big round nose. It could blow bubbles from its nose, big ones and small ones. Blub, blub, BLUB!

Popplio practiced every day to make bigger bubbles. It huffed and puffed and blew. Sometimes the bubbles popped right away. Pop! But Popplio kept trying. And one day, it blew a bubble so big that it could sit inside it! Popplio floated up in its bubble, giggling, over the beach and the waves. Then, pop! Splash! Into the sea it went.

Brionne was a sea lion Pokémon that loved to dance. It danced on the beach and in the water, and as it danced, it blew sparkly water balloons into the air.

Brionne's dances were so beautiful that the other Pokémon stopped to watch. Twirl, splash, spin! The water balloons floated around it like bubbles, catching the sunlight. When a balloon popped, a little shower of sparkly water rained down. "More, Brionne!" cried the children. And Brionne danced until the sun went down.

Primarina was a beautiful sea Pokémon with long, flowing hair like the ocean. It had the most beautiful singing voice in the world.

When Primarina sang, the water danced with it. Bubbles floated up and spun in the air. The waves moved in time with the music. On moonlit nights, all the Primarina gathered on the rocks and sang together, and the sound drifted across the sea to the sleeping town. The children in their beds heard the music, and they dreamed of mermaids and moonlight.

Pikipek was a little woodpecker Pokémon that could peck very, very fast. Peck, peck, peck, peck! It could peck a tree sixteen times in one second!

Pikipek used its fast pecking to make little holes in trees for its friends to live in. Peck, peck, peck! A cozy hole for a little Grubbin. Peck, peck, peck! A snug hole for a Cutiefly. Soon, the whole tree was full of little homes. "Pikipek, you're the best builder!" said its friends. Pikipek pecked a little heart into the bark to say thank you.

Trumbeak was a bird Pokémon with a long beak, and it could make all sorts of sounds with it. Toot! Honk! Whistle! Tweet!

Trumbeak could make over a hundred different sounds. It could sound like a trumpet, a horn or even a little bell. When the jungle Pokémon had a party, Trumbeak was the band! Toot, toot! Honk, honk! Ding, ding! Everyone danced to its music. And at the end of the party, Trumbeak played a soft, sleepy tune, and everyone went home to bed.

Toucannon was a big bird Pokémon with a large, colorful beak. When it got excited, its beak got very warm, almost hot!

Toucannon used its beak to talk to other Toucannon. It tapped its beak on tree branches. Tap, tap, tap. The sound echoed through the jungle. Other Toucannon tapped back. Tap, tap. "Hello!" "Hello!" They talked like this all day, tapping messages across the jungle. People in the village liked to listen. It sounded like the jungle had a heartbeat.

Yungoos was a small, brown Pokémon with a long body and a very big appetite. It was always hungry, and it walked around the town all day looking for food. Sniff, sniff, sniff!

Yungoos had a very simple plan: walk, find food, eat, repeat. It walked down one street. Sniff! A berry. Munch! It walked down another street. Sniff! A crumb. Munch! By the end of the day, it had walked all over town. Then it curled up and fell asleep, dreaming of tomorrow's snacks.

Gumshoos was a patient Pokémon that loved to watch and wait. It could stay in one spot for hours, keeping an eye on things, like a detective.

When something went missing in town, people asked Gumshoos to help. A lost hat? Gumshoos waited by the park bench and watched. Hmm. Then it saw a Pidove flying by with a hat in its beak! Gumshoos followed it all the way to its nest. There was the hat, being used as a cozy bed. Mystery solved!

Grubbin was a little bug Pokémon with big jaws. It used its jaws to dig in the ground and to climb up trees. Chomp, climb, chomp, climb!

Grubbin liked places where there was electricity, like near power lines. It felt the buzz and wiggled happily. Bzzzz. When it found a good spot, it dug a little burrow and settled in. "Ahh, cozy and buzzy," it said. Its friends thought it was a bit strange. But Grubbin knew what it liked.

Charjabug was a bug Pokémon that looked a lot like a battery. It could store electricity inside its body and share it with anyone who needed it.

Campers loved Charjabug. When they went camping in the woods, Charjabug came along. When their flashlights ran out of power, Charjabug zapped them back to life. Bzzt! When their phones needed charging, Charjabug helped. "What would we do without you, Charjabug?" they said. Charjabug buzzed happily. It liked being useful.

When Charjabug touched a Thunder Stone, it became Vikavolt, a flying bug Pokémon with big jaws that crackled with electricity. It could fly very fast and very far.

Vikavolt loved to fly through the jungle, zipping between the trees. Zzzip! It could fly so fast that it left a trail of sparks behind it. At night, the trail glowed in the dark, like a line of fairy lights. The children followed the sparkly trail through the jungle and found Vikavolt resting on a branch, glowing happily.

Crabrawler was a crab Pokémon with big fists, and it loved to climb. It always wanted to reach the very top of things: the top of a rock, the top of a tree, the top of a mountain.

Crabrawler's favorite food was berries, and the best berries grew at the top of the trees. So it practiced climbing every day. Climb, climb, slip! Climb, climb, slip! It never gave up. And one day, it reached the very top of the tallest tree and found the biggest, juiciest berry of all. "I did it!" it shouted. The berry was worth every slip.

When Crabrawler climbed all the way to the top of a snowy mountain, it became Crabominable, a big crab Pokémon with fluffy white fur. Its fur kept it warm in the cold.

Crabominable lived on the snowy mountaintop, where it could see the whole world. It was a bit lonely up there. So it started making snowmen to keep it company. One snowman. Two snowmen. Ten snowmen! Soon, the mountaintop was full of snowy friends. And when the children climbed up to visit, Crabominable was the happiest crab on the mountain.

Oricorio was a bird Pokémon that loved to dance. And here's the amazing part: when it drank nectar from different flowers, it changed its whole style of dancing!

When Oricorio drank red nectar, it danced a fiery, passionate dance. When it drank yellow nectar, it danced a bouncy, cheerful dance. When it drank pink nectar, it danced a soft, sweet dance. And when it drank purple nectar, it danced a slow, graceful dance. The island children loved to bring Oricorio different flowers, just to see which dance it would do next.

Cutiefly was a tiny bee Pokémon that could see the glow of flowers. Each flower had its own special glow, and Cutiefly could tell which ones had the sweetest nectar.

Cutiefly zipped from flower to flower, faster than you could follow. Zip, zip, zip! It sipped a little nectar from each one. When it found a person with a happy, flowery glow, it buzzed around their head, thinking they might be a flower! The children giggled when Cutiefly buzzed around them. "I'm not a flower!" they laughed. Cutiefly wasn't so sure.

Ribombee was a little bee Pokémon with a fluffy scarf. It collected flower pollen and rolled it into little balls, like tiny sweet treats.

Ribombee made pollen puffs of all different kinds. Some made you feel happy. Some made you feel energetic. Some made you feel calm. It shared them with its friends. "Here, try this one!" Pop! A little puff of sweet pollen. "Mmm," said its friends. Ribombee's pollen puffs were the best treats on the island.

Rockruff was a little puppy Pokémon with rocks around its neck. When Rockruff loved someone, it rubbed its neck rocks against them. That was its way of saying, "I love you!"

Rockruff rubbed its rocks against its trainer's leg every morning. Rub, rub! It was a little bit scratchy, but its trainer always smiled. "I love you too, Rockruff." Then they went for a walk, and Rockruff wagged its tail so hard that its whole body wiggled. Rockruff was the most loyal puppy in the world.

Lycanroc was a wolf Pokémon that came in different forms. Some Lycanroc were born in the daytime, and they were calm and fast. Some were born at night, and they had a wild, red mane.

No matter which form it was, Lycanroc was always loyal to its friends. When its trainer needed help, Lycanroc came running, faster than the wind. Whoosh! It found lost things, guarded the house and played fetch for hours. And at night, it sat on the porch and howled at the moon. Ow-ooo! Good night, moon.

Wishiwashi was a tiny fish Pokémon, very small and a little bit shy. On its own, it was easy to miss. But Wishiwashi had a secret.

When Wishiwashi felt scared, it called out to its friends. And all the other Wishiwashi came swimming, hundreds of them! They swam together in a big group, so close that they looked like one giant fish. Whoosh! Nobody bothered a giant fish. Together, the little Wishiwashi were big and strong. And together, they were never scared.

Mareanie was a little sea Pokémon covered in spiky tentacles. It crawled along the bottom of the beach, looking at everything with its big eyes.

Mareanie was a bit shy, and its spikes kept it safe. But it wanted to make friends. So it practiced being gentle. It tucked its spikes in and crawled up to a little Wishiwashi. "Hello," it said softly. "Want to explore the tide pools with me?" The Wishiwashi said yes. And they explored all day, finding shells, starfish and shiny pebbles.

Toxapex was a sea Pokémon that lived inside a dome made of its own spiky legs. It sat on the bottom of the sea, safe and snug inside its spiky house.

Toxapex was very good at staying safe. When the big waves came, it closed its dome and waited. When the waves were gone, it opened up again and peeked out. "Is it safe?" It was. So Toxapex spread its legs and let the little fish swim in close. Inside the dome was the safest place in the sea.

Mudbray was a little donkey Pokémon that loved to play in the mud. Splish, splash, squelch! The muddier, the better!

Mudbray rolled in the mud, jumped in the mud and even ate a little bit of mud. "Mmm, yummy!" Its friends laughed. When it came home, it was covered head to hoof in mud. "Mudbray!" said its trainer, laughing. "Bath time!" Mudbray didn't like baths very much. But it liked getting muddy again the next day.

Mudsdale was a big, strong horse Pokémon with legs covered in heavy mud, like boots. Its mud boots made it so strong that it could pull a big truck!

But Mudsdale used its strength to help. It pulled heavy carts full of fruit to the market. It carried big loads of wood to the builders. Clip, clop, clip, clop! People loved Mudsdale. "Thank you, Mudsdale!" they said, patting its muddy neck. Mudsdale snorted happily. It liked being strong for its friends.

Dewpider was a little spider Pokémon that lived in the water. It carried a bubble of water on its head, like a little helmet.

When Dewpider climbed out of the water, it kept its bubble on its head so it could breathe. Bloop, bloop! It walked around the pond, its bubble wobbling. The children thought it looked funny. "Your hat is made of water!" they giggled. Dewpider wobbled its bubble proudly. It was the best hat in the whole pond.

Araquanid was a spider Pokémon with a big bubble of water around its head. It was very caring, and it shared its bubble with little Pokémon to keep them safe.

When a little Pokémon couldn't swim very well, Araquanid gave it a little bubble to wear. "Now you can explore underwater too," it said. The little Pokémon put on the bubble and dove into the pond with Araquanid. They saw fish, shells and pretty water plants. "Wow!" said the little one. Araquanid smiled.

Fomantis was a little pink Pokémon with leaves that looked like little blades. It liked to sleep in the sunlight, soaking up the warmth.

During the day, Fomantis took long sunny naps. Zzz. At night, it woke up and went looking for a new sunny spot for tomorrow. It wanted the very best spot, with the most sunshine. "Here?" No, too shady. "Here?" No, too windy. "Here!" Perfect! And Fomantis curled up, ready for tomorrow's nap.

Lurantis was a beautiful pink Pokémon that looked like a flower. It took great care of its colors, making sure they were always bright and beautiful.

Lurantis spent a lot of time on its appearance. It polished its leaves. It brushed its petals. It made sure every color was perfect. When it walked through the garden, people stopped and stared. "What a beautiful flower!" they said. Then Lurantis turned around and waved. "I'm not a flower," it said. "But thank you!"

Morelull was a little mushroom Pokémon that glowed in the dark. Its cap flickered softly, like a little night-light.

At night, Morelull floated through the forest, glowing. Blink, blink, glow. When it shook its cap, a little cloud of sparkly spores floated out. Anyone who breathed them in felt very, very sleepy. Yaaawn. So if you can't fall asleep tonight, just imagine Morelull floating by your window, blinking its soft light and shaking out its sleepy spores.

Shiinotic was a big mushroom Pokémon that glowed in the dark forest. Its light was soft and blinky, and it made the forest look like a magical place.

People walking through the forest at night sometimes saw strange, blinking lights. "Is that a fairy?" they whispered. It was Shiinotic, glowing softly. When the people got lost, Shiinotic floated ahead of them, blinking its lights. They followed the lights out of the forest. "Thank you, little lights," they said. Shiinotic blinked happily.

Salandit was a little black lizard Pokémon that lived near volcanoes. It was quick and sneaky, darting between rocks. Zip, zip, zip!

Salandit liked to play tag with its friends. It was so quick that nobody could catch it. Zip! Behind a rock. Zip! Under a log. Zip! On top of a tree. "Where did it go?" asked its friends. Then Salandit popped out right behind them and tagged them. "Gotcha!" It was the fastest player of tag on the whole island.

Salazzle was a sleek, elegant lizard Pokémon with a fiery tail. It liked to keep everything in order, and it led a group of Salandit.

Salazzle was very proud of its group. It taught the little Salandit how to be quick and clever. "Quick, quick! Follow me!" The Salandit followed Salazzle everywhere, in a long line. Zip, zip, zip, zip! When they found a warm, sunny rock, Salazzle let them all rest. "Good job, everyone," it said. The Salandit were very proud.

Stufful was a little bear cub Pokémon that looked soft and cuddly, like a stuffed toy. But Stufful didn't like being touched. If you tried to hug it, it wriggled away!

Stufful liked its own space. It was very strong for its size, and it liked to show it. It carried heavy logs and big rocks, all by itself. "I don't need help," it said. But one day, it tried to carry a log that was too heavy. "Ugh!" A friend came over and helped carry the other end. "Thanks," said Stufful, a little bit shy. Maybe some help was okay.

Bewear was a big bear Pokémon that loved to give hugs. The trouble was, Bewear was very, very strong, and its hugs were much too tight!

When Bewear hugged its friends, they squeaked. Squeak! "Too tight, Bewear!" Bewear felt sad. It just wanted to show how much it loved them. So it practiced. It hugged a pillow, very gently. It hugged a flower, very gently. And one day, it gave its best friend the softest, gentlest hug ever. "Perfect!" said its friend. Bewear was the happiest bear in the world.

Bounsweet was a little Pokémon that smelled like sweet, juicy fruit. Mmm! Everyone who smelled it felt happy and hungry at the same time.

Bounsweet bounced around the garden, boing, boing, boing, leaving a sweet smell everywhere it went. The other Pokémon followed their noses. "Something smells delicious!" they said. Then they found Bounsweet, bouncing and smiling. "It's just me!" it giggled. And they all laughed and went to find some real fruit together.

Steenee was a cheerful Pokémon with a leafy skirt, and it loved to dance and twirl. When it spun around, it smelled sweet, like a basket of fruit.

Steenee was always happy. It hummed little songs and danced through the meadow. Twirl, hop, twirl! The other Pokémon couldn't help smiling when they saw it. "Steenee is so happy," they said. "It makes us happy too!" And they all joined in, twirling and hopping through the meadow together.

Tsareena was a tall, elegant Pokémon with a crown of leaves. It was like a queen, graceful and proud, and it could kick very high.

Tsareena held a dance class for the little Bounsweet and Steenee. "Point your toes," it said. "Lift your arms. And kick!" The little ones tried their best. Kick! Wobble! Kick! Wobble! Tsareena smiled. "Very good," it said. "You'll be dancing like queens in no time."

Comfey was a tiny fairy Pokémon that loved flowers. It picked flowers and strung them together to make beautiful flower necklaces.

Comfey's flower necklaces smelled so lovely that anyone who wore one felt calm and peaceful. When someone was having a hard day, Comfey made them a necklace. "For you," it said, putting it around their neck. They breathed in the sweet smell. Ahh. Everything felt a little better. Comfey made necklaces for everyone on the island.

Oranguru was a wise old Pokémon with a big purple cape of fur and a leaf fan. It lived in the treetops and liked to sit and think about life.

Oranguru helped the other Pokémon with their problems. When two Pokémon argued, Oranguru listened to both sides. "Hmm," it said, fanning itself. "Have you tried sharing?" They tried sharing. It worked! When a little Pokémon was lost, Oranguru gave directions. Everyone in the jungle knew: if you have a problem, ask Oranguru.

Passimian was a monkey Pokémon that lived in big groups, and they loved to play games together. Their favorite game was a lot like football, but with a berry!

The Passimian passed the berry back and forth across the jungle. Toss! Catch! Toss! Catch! Nobody ever dropped it. When one Passimian made a great catch, all the others cheered. Hooray! They played until the sun went down, and then they shared the berry for dinner. Teamwork tastes the best.

Wimpod was a little bug Pokémon that lived on the beach. It was very shy, and when anything came close, it ran away as fast as its many legs could carry it! Skitter, skitter, skitter!

But Wimpod had an important job. It ate up all the bits of old seaweed and leftover scraps on the beach, so the sand stayed clean and sparkly. The children noticed. "The beach is so clean today!" they said. They never saw Wimpod, hiding behind a rock. But Wimpod felt very proud.

Golisopod was a big bug Pokémon that looked like a knight, with strong claws and a hard shell. It lived in underwater caves and was very brave.

Golisopod sat quietly in its cave, thinking. It didn't like noise or fuss. But when a little Wimpod got lost in the dark caves, Golisopod went out to find it. It searched every tunnel until it found the little one, shivering in the dark. "Come on," said Golisopod gently. "Let's go home." And the Wimpod followed its knight back through the caves.

Sandygast was a little ghost Pokémon that looked like a sandcastle, with a shovel stuck on top. It lived on the beach and loved collecting sand.

Sandygast got bigger and bigger as it collected more sand. Scoop, scoop! The children on the beach liked to help. They brought it buckets of sand, and Sandygast grew taller and taller. "You're the biggest sandcastle on the beach!" they cheered. Sandygast wiggled its shovel happily. It was the only sandcastle that could say thank you.

Palossand was a big ghost Pokémon that looked like a giant sandcastle, with towers and walls and a little shovel. It was the king of the beach!

Palossand loved it when children came to play. It let them climb on its towers and slide down its walls. Wheee! When the waves washed away some of its sand, Palossand just collected more. The children helped, scooping sand and patting it into place. "We're building a castle that's alive!" they said. And Palossand laughed, its towers shaking.

Pyukumuku was a little black sea Pokémon that liked to lie on the beach. It didn't move very much, and it was very squishy.

When people found Pyukumuku on the beach, they always picked it up and tossed it back into the sea. Splash! "There you go, little one," they said. But Pyukumuku always came back to the beach. It liked the warm sand! So people tossed it back again. Splash! And it came back again. It was a game that never ended, and Pyukumuku didn't mind at all.

Type: Null was a Pokémon that wore a heavy helmet on its head. It had been made by scientists, and at first, it was very lonely and didn't know who to trust.

Type: Null lived in a quiet place, away from everyone. But one day, a kind girl came to visit. She brought it berries and talked to it softly. She came back the next day, and the next. Slowly, Type: Null began to trust her. It walked a little closer. Then a little closer. And one day, it let her touch its helmet. They were friends.

When Type: Null learned to trust its friend completely, it broke free of its heavy helmet and became Silvally! Now it could see the world clearly for the first time.

Silvally ran across the fields, free and happy. Its tail streamed behind it, and its eyes sparkled. It ran to its best friend and nuzzled her. "Thank you," it seemed to say. "You helped me be free." The girl hugged Silvally tight. Trust had made them both stronger.

Minior was a Pokémon that lived high up in the sky, in a hard shell like a little meteor. Sometimes it fell down to the ground like a shooting star!

When Minior's shell cracked, out came its colorful core: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo or violet! The children on the mountain loved to look for Minior after a meteor shower. "I found a blue one!" "I found a red one!" Minior blinked at them with its sparkly eyes. Then it floated back up to the sky to join its friends.

Komala was a little koala Pokémon that was always asleep. Always! It hugged a log and snoozed all day and all night. Zzz.

Komala ate while it was asleep. It walked while it was asleep. It even played games while it was asleep! The other Pokémon thought it was amazing. "Does Komala ever wake up?" they asked. Nobody knew. But Komala always looked very happy, hugging its log and dreaming its sweet dreams. Zzz.

Turtonator was a turtle Pokémon with a spiky shell on its back. It lived near volcanoes and liked to sit on the warm rocks in the sun.

Turtonator's shell was so warm that the children on the island held their hands near it on cool mornings. Not too close! When Turtonator was happy, little puffs of smoke came out of its nose. Puff, puff! The children knew that meant Turtonator liked having them around. And they always brought it a nice cool drink of water as a thank you.

Togedemaru was a little round Pokémon with spiky fur. When there was lightning, its spikes stood up and caught the electricity, like a little lightning rod!

When a thunderstorm came, Togedemaru rolled up into a spiky ball and caught the lightning. Zap! Its fur crackled with energy. Then it rolled around the house, bouncing and zapping with excitement. Bounce, zap, bounce! Its family laughed. "Togedemaru, calm down!" But Togedemaru was having too much fun.

Mimikyu was a little Pokémon that wore a homemade costume. The costume looked a bit like a Pikachu, because Mimikyu knew that everyone loved Pikachu, and it wanted to be loved too.

Mimikyu was very lonely. It wanted friends more than anything. One day, a little girl saw it in its costume. "Hello, little Pikachu!" she said. Mimikyu was nervous. Would she still like it if she knew the truth? "Actually," it said quietly, "I'm Mimikyu." The girl smiled. "That's okay," she said. "I like you just the way you are." Mimikyu's heart felt very warm.

Bruxish was a colorful fish Pokémon with big teeth. When it ground its teeth together, it made a funny sound. Grrrind, grrrind!

Bruxish liked to swim around the coral reef, showing off its bright colors: pink, yellow and blue. The other fish thought it was very pretty. But when Bruxish smiled, its big teeth showed, and they laughed. "You have the biggest smile in the sea!" Bruxish laughed too, grinding its teeth. Grrrind! Then it swam away, smiling even bigger.

Drampa was a gentle dragon Pokémon with fluffy white fur, like a cloud. It lived high in the mountains, but it loved to come down and play with the children in town.

Drampa was very kind and very patient. When the children came to see it, it let them ride on its back and slide down its long neck. Wheee! It told them stories about the mountains and the clouds. "Tell us another one, Drampa!" And Drampa always did. The children loved Drampa, and Drampa loved them right back.

Dhelmise was a ghost Pokémon made of seaweed and an old ship's anchor. It floated through the sea, drifting with the currents.

Dhelmise liked to explore old shipwrecks at the bottom of the ocean. It swam through the broken ships, looking at old treasures: rusty keys, old coins, chipped teacups. "I wonder whose these were," it thought. Sometimes, Dhelmise brought a treasure up to the beach and left it for the children to find. "Look, a treasure from the sea!"

Jangmo-o was a little dragon Pokémon with scales on its head. When it banged its scales together, they made a clang, like a little drum. Clang, clang!

Jangmo-o practiced every day to get stronger. It ran, it jumped and it clanged its scales. Clang, clang, clang! It wanted to be brave and strong, like the big dragon Pokémon. "Someday," it said, "I'll be the bravest dragon of all!" And it practiced even harder.

Hakamo-o was a dragon Pokémon with scales that clanged when it moved. It liked to make music with its scales, banging them together in a rhythm. Clang, clang, clang-clang!

Hakamo-o played its scale music for its friends. The jungle Pokémon gathered around and danced. Clang-clang! Stomp-stomp! Clang-clang! It was the best drum music in the jungle. When the song was over, everyone cheered, and Hakamo-o took a bow, its scales clanging one last time.

Kommo-o was a big dragon Pokémon covered in shiny golden scales. When it moved, the scales clinked and chimed together, making beautiful music. Ching, ching, ching!

Kommo-o's scales were so beautiful that people made old ones into musical instruments. When it walked through the village, it sounded like a whole orchestra was coming. Ching, clang, chime! The children ran out to listen and dance. Kommo-o swayed back and forth, making its scales ring, and the whole village danced along.

Tapu Koko was a legendary guardian of the islands. It was very curious and full of energy, and it loved to zip around, crackling with electricity.

Tapu Koko watched over its island. It zipped across the sky like a flash of lightning, checking on everyone. When it saw children playing, it zipped down to watch. Zap! The children waved. "Hello, Tapu Koko!" It crackled happily and zipped back up into the clouds, keeping the island safe.

Tapu Lele was a legendary guardian of the islands. It was pink and full of mischief, and it scattered sparkling scales that could help anyone feel better.

Tapu Lele floated around its island, sprinkling its sparkly scales. Twinkle, twinkle! Wherever the scales landed, tired people felt rested and sad people felt happy. "Thank you, Tapu Lele!" they called. Tapu Lele giggled and floated away, sprinkling more sparkles as it went.

Tapu Bulu was a legendary guardian of the islands. It was a bit lazy, but very strong. When it rang the bell on its tail, plants grew everywhere around it.

Tapu Bulu liked to take long naps in the forest. Zzz. But when it woke up and rang its bell, ding, ding, the trees grew taller and the flowers bloomed bigger. The island children always knew when Tapu Bulu was awake, because suddenly the whole island was greener than before.

Tapu Fini was a legendary guardian of the islands. It could make a soft, magical mist that calmed everyone who was near it.

When people were worried or upset, Tapu Fini floated nearby and made its gentle mist. The mist swirled around them, cool and soft. Everyone took a deep breath. Ahh. They felt calm and peaceful again. Tapu Fini watched over its island from a foggy lake, keeping everything quiet and calm.

Cosmog was a tiny Pokémon made of gas, like a little purple cloud with stars inside. It was very curious and loved to explore.

Cosmog floated around, looking at everything. "What's this? What's that?" It was so light that the wind could blow it away! So its friend, a little girl, carried it in her bag to keep it safe. Cosmog peeked out of the bag, looking at the world. "Pew!" it said. That meant, "Thank you for keeping me safe."

Cosmoem was a little Pokémon that looked like a hard golden ball. It didn't move at all. It just floated quietly, very, very still.

Inside its hard shell, Cosmoem was growing. Something amazing was happening. Its friends waited patiently beside it. "When will Cosmoem wake up?" they asked. Nobody knew. But they waited and waited. And one night, under the light of the sun and moon, Cosmoem began to glow.

Solgaleo was a legendary Pokémon with a shining mane like the sun. People called it the beast that calls the sun, and it glowed with warm, golden light.

When Solgaleo roared, the sun came out from behind the clouds. Rooooar! The island turned bright and warm, and everyone smiled. Solgaleo ran across the land, its mane shining, bringing light wherever it went. And at the end of the day, it watched the sunset, glowing gold, until the moon came out.

Lunala was a legendary Pokémon with big wings like the night sky, full of stars. People called it the beast that calls the moon, and it glowed with soft, silvery light.

When Lunala spread its wings, the moon came out, full and bright. The night sky sparkled with stars. Lunala flew over the sleeping town, its wings shimmering with moonlight. Everyone in town slept peacefully, dreaming beautiful dreams. Lunala watched over them until morning, then folded its starry wings and rested.

Nihilego was a strange Pokémon from another world, called an Ultra Beast. It looked like a floating jellyfish made of glass, and nobody knew much about it.

Nihilego had come through a hole in the sky into our world. Everything was new and strange to it. It floated around, looking at trees, clouds and flowers. It had never seen anything like them before. Nobody knew what it was thinking. But it floated gently, curious and quiet, exploring its new world.

Buzzwole was an Ultra Beast with big, strong muscles. It came from another world, and it loved to show off how strong it was by flexing. Flex!

Buzzwole flexed its arms. Flex! It flexed its legs. Flex! It lifted big rocks and posed. Flex! The Pokémon on the island didn't quite know what to make of it. But the children loved it. They flexed their arms too. "Look, I'm strong like Buzzwole!" Buzzwole flexed happily. It had found some new friends.

Pheromosa was an Ultra Beast from another world. It was very graceful and elegant, and it could run faster than almost anything.

Pheromosa didn't like to get dirty. It walked carefully, tiptoeing around puddles and mud. But when it ran, oh, how it ran! Zoom! It was a blur of white across the beach. The children tried to race it. "Ready, set, go!" And by the time they said "go," Pheromosa was already at the finish line.

Xurkitree was an Ultra Beast from another world. It looked like a tangle of wires and lights, and it was full of crackling electricity.

Xurkitree liked to stand still, pushing its feet into the ground like roots, and soak up electricity. Bzzz. When it had a lot of electricity, it lit up like a big festive tree, with sparkling lights all over. The children on the island came to see it at night. "It's like a holiday tree!" they said. Xurkitree sparkled even brighter.

Celesteela was an Ultra Beast from another world. It was very tall and looked like a rocket, and it could fly high into the sky by blasting fire from its arms.

Celesteela liked to fly up, up, up, as high as the clouds. Whoosh! Then it floated back down, gently, like a feather. The children on the island watched it launch. "Three, two, one, liftoff!" they shouted. And Celesteela blasted off into the sky, just for them.

Kartana was a tiny Ultra Beast from another world. It looked like it was made of folded paper, like a little origami figure. It was very light, but very sharp.

Kartana was so light that it floated on the breeze. It drifted around the island, watching everything with its tiny eyes. The children folded paper to look like Kartana. "Look, we made a Kartana!" Kartana floated down and looked at their paper creations. Then it folded itself into a little bow, as if to say, "Very nice!"

Guzzlord was an Ultra Beast from another world, and it was always, always hungry. It could eat almost anything: rocks, trees, even old buildings!

So the island Pokémon came up with a plan. They gathered all the fallen logs, old branches and scraps from the beach, and they made Guzzlord a giant meal. Munch, munch, crunch! Guzzlord ate it all and patted its tummy. "Burp!" Then it lay down and fell asleep. For the first time ever, Guzzlord felt full.

Necrozma was a mysterious legendary Pokémon made of dark crystals. Long ago, it was full of bright, shining light, but it lost its light, and now it searched for it everywhere.

Necrozma flew through the sky, looking for light. When it saw the sun, it felt warm. When it saw the stars, it felt hopeful. People say that if you see a rainbow, that's Necrozma's light, shining through the sky. And one day, Necrozma will find all its light again and glow brighter than ever.

Magearna was a Mythical Pokémon made by people long, long ago, about five hundred years ago. It was made of metal, but in its chest was a special heart that made it alive.

Magearna had been sleeping for a very long time. When it finally woke up, it looked around at the world with its big, curious eyes. Everything had changed! But a kind girl took care of it, and they became best friends. Magearna's heart glowed warm and pink. It had been made with love, and it gave love back.

Marshadow was a shy Mythical Pokémon that hid in shadows. It was so shy that very few people had ever seen it. But it watched everything from the shadows.

Marshadow could copy what other Pokémon did, moving exactly like them. When the children played games, Marshadow copied them from the shadows. Jump! Marshadow's shadow jumped too. Spin! Marshadow's shadow spun. The children never knew. But sometimes, if you look very carefully at your shadow, it might be doing something a little bit different.

Poipole was a little Ultra Beast from another world. It was small and purple and very cute, and it liked people a lot.

Poipole was curious and friendly. It floated up to people and said, "Bee-bee!" That was its way of saying hello. The children on the island thought it was adorable. They played with it, and Poipole laughed and spun around. "Bee-bee!" It liked our world very much, especially the people in it.

Naganadel was a long, graceful Ultra Beast with big wings. It flew so fast that it zoomed across the sky like a purple streak.

Naganadel loved flying more than anything. It zoomed over the ocean, over the mountains and over the island towns. Whoosh! When it found a place it liked, it hovered there for a while and looked around. "This world is beautiful," it seemed to think. Then it zoomed off again, to see what other beautiful places it could find.

Stakataka was an Ultra Beast that looked like a big stone wall. And it wasn't just one Pokémon. It was lots of little creatures all stacked together like bricks!

Each brick was its own little being, and they all worked together to make one big Pokémon. When Stakataka wanted to move, all the bricks had to agree. "Left!" "Left!" "Left!" Then the whole wall moved left. Stomp! The children on the island watched in amazement. "It's like a walking castle!"

Blacephalon was an Ultra Beast that looked like a clown. It loved to make people laugh with funny tricks and juggling.

Blacephalon juggled colorful balls of fire, round and round. Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Then it did a funny dance, wobbling and spinning. The children laughed and clapped. "More, Blacephalon!" So it did its best trick of all: it made a burst of colorful sparks pop out of its head, like confetti. Pop! The children cheered and cheered.

Zeraora was a Mythical Pokémon that could move as fast as lightning. It had electric claws, and it crackled with energy wherever it went.

Zeraora was very quick, but it was also very careful. It zipped through the forest, faster than anyone could see. Zip! When it stopped, little sparks crackled in the air around it. The forest Pokémon loved to watch it run. "Zeraora is so fast!" they said. And Zeraora zoomed by again, just to show them.

Meltan was a tiny Mythical Pokémon with a hex nut for a head. It loved to eat metal, and it could melt down metal things and turn them into energy.

Meltan was very small, but it was always busy. It looked for old, rusty metal things: old nails, broken bolts and bent spoons. Munch, munch, melt! It turned them into energy and wiggled happily. The people in town were glad. "Meltan cleans up all our old metal!" they said. Meltan just wiggled its little arms and smiled.

Melmetal was a big Pokémon made of liquid metal. It was made of lots of little Meltan all joined together, and its body was strong and shiny.

Melmetal was very strong, but it was also gentle. It helped the townspeople build things: bridges, playgrounds and big shiny statues. Clang, clang, shine! The little Meltan watched and cheered. "Melmetal is the strongest!" they said. Melmetal smiled down at them. "We're all strong," it said, "when we work together."

Grookey was a little green monkey Pokémon with a stick in its hair. It loved to drum on everything with its stick: rocks, logs, buckets and even its own head! Tap, tap, tap!

When Grookey drummed, something magical happened. The plants nearby grew a little bit. The flowers opened wider. The grass got greener. Tap, tap, tap, grow! Grookey drummed all over the garden, and soon it was the greenest garden in the village. The gardener laughed. "Keep drumming, Grookey!"

Thwackey was a monkey Pokémon with two sticks, and it drummed even faster than Grookey. Tappa-tappa-tappa-tap! It could drum so fast that its sticks became a blur.

Thwackey got so into its drumming that it forgot everything else. It forgot lunch. It forgot naps. It even forgot to go home! Its friends had to tap it on the shoulder. "Thwackey! Time for dinner!" Thwackey blinked. "Oh!" Then it drummed a happy rhythm all the way home. Tappa-tappa-tap!

Rillaboom was a big gorilla Pokémon with a giant drum made from a tree stump. When it drummed, the beat was so strong that the roots of the trees moved to the music!

Rillaboom was the leader of the forest band. Boom, boom, BOOM! All the Grookey and Thwackey drummed along. The trees swayed, the flowers danced and the whole forest moved to the beat. When the music stopped, Rillaboom smiled. "Good job, everyone." And the forest grew a little greener that night.

Scorbunny was a little white rabbit Pokémon full of energy. It could never sit still! It ran and jumped and hopped all over the place. Zoom, zoom, zoom!

When Scorbunny ran, the pads on its feet got warmer and warmer, until they glowed with heat. On cold mornings, Scorbunny ran circles around the yard to warm up. Then its friends sat on its warm feet to warm their paws. "Ahh, Scorbunny, you're like a little heater!" Scorbunny wiggled its ears happily and ran another lap.

Raboot was a rabbit Pokémon with fluffy fur like a hoodie. It was a little bit cool and a little bit shy, and it liked to kick pebbles around with its feet.

Raboot could keep a pebble bouncing on its feet for a long, long time. Tap, tap, tap, tap! It never let the pebble touch the ground. The other Pokémon watched in amazement. "How do you do that?" Raboot shrugged, trying to look cool. But secretly, it was very happy that they had noticed. It bounced the pebble even higher.

Cinderace was a tall rabbit Pokémon who loved football. It could juggle a pebble with its feet until it got warm and glowing, like a fiery football!

Cinderace was the star player on the village team. It ran down the field, bouncing its glowing ball. Tap, tap, tap, kick! GOAL! The crowd cheered. "Cinderace! Cinderace!" But Cinderace's favorite part was after the game, when it taught the little Scorbunny how to kick. "Like this," it said. "Practice every day, and someday you'll score too."

Sobble was a little blue lizard Pokémon that was very, very shy. When it got scared, it cried, and its tears made everyone around it cry too!

When Sobble went into the water, its body turned see-through, and it became invisible. So whenever it felt nervous, it hid in a pond. "Where's Sobble?" asked its friends. A little bubble floated up. Blub. "There!" They waited patiently by the water. Slowly, Sobble peeked out. "You're safe with us," they said. And Sobble smiled through its tears.

Drizzile was a clever lizard Pokémon who liked to plan things out. It could make balls of water with its hands, like water balloons, and it loved using them in clever ways.

Drizzile planned the best water balloon game ever. It hid balloons all around the garden, behind trees and under bushes. Then it invited its friends. "Ready, set, go!" Everyone ran around, finding balloons and tossing them. Splash! Splash! Drizzile had planned it so well that everyone got wet, and everyone laughed.

Inteleon was a tall, sleek lizard Pokémon that looked like a secret agent. It was cool, calm and very clever, and it had lots of hidden talents.

Inteleon could glide through the air using the fins on its sides. Whoosh! It could see far away with a special eye. And it could squirt water from its fingertip, very carefully, to water the tiniest flowers. Squirt, squirt! The children thought Inteleon was the coolest Pokémon ever. "Can we be secret agents too?" they asked. Inteleon winked.

Skwovet was a little squirrel Pokémon that loved berries more than anything. It stuffed berries into its cheeks until they were so full that its face looked like a big round ball!

Skwovet always worried that it might run out of berries. So it stuffed more and more into its cheeks. Cram, cram, cram! "Skwovet, you have enough!" said its friends. Skwovet looked at its full cheeks and thought about it. Then it opened its mouth and shared some with everyone. Pop, pop, pop! It felt much better. Sharing was better than stuffing.

Greedent was a big squirrel Pokémon with a fluffy tail, and it stored berries in its tail! The tail was so full of berries that it looked like a big bunch of grapes.

Greedent was always looking for more berries. But sometimes, when it walked, berries fell out of its tail. Plop, plop, plop! It didn't even notice. The little Pokémon followed behind it, picking up the dropped berries. "Thank you, Greedent!" they said, munching happily. Greedent turned around, confused. "For what?" It had no idea it was sharing.

Rookidee was a little blue bird Pokémon, and it was very brave. Even though it was small, it liked to fly right up to big Pokémon and chirp at them. Chirp! Chirp! "I'm not scared of you!"

The big Pokémon thought Rookidee was very funny. A big Snorlax looked down at it. "Chirp!" said Rookidee bravely. Snorlax yawned. Rookidee fluffed up its feathers and chirped even louder. Snorlax smiled and rolled over. Rookidee flew off, very proud. It had been brave, and that was what mattered.

Corvisquire was a clever bird Pokémon that was very good at solving puzzles. It used stones and sticks as tools, and it was one of the smartest birds in the land.

When Corvisquire wanted a nut that was too hard to crack, it picked up a stone and tapped the nut. Tap, tap, crack! When it wanted a bug hidden in a log, it used a stick to fish it out. The children watched in amazement. "Corvisquire is so smart!" they said. Corvisquire puffed up its chest. It liked being the clever one.

Corviknight was a big, strong bird Pokémon with shiny armor feathers. It could carry people through the sky, and in some lands, it worked as a flying taxi!

When people needed to travel far, they called a Corviknight. It came swooping down, and they climbed into a little carriage that it carried in its claws. Whoosh! Up into the sky they went, over the hills and towns. The children loved riding with Corviknight. "Look, I can see our house!" Corviknight flew smoothly, never in a hurry, until everyone arrived safely.

Blipbug was a little bug Pokémon covered in tiny hairs. The hairs helped it sense everything around it, and Blipbug was very curious about the world.

Blipbug liked to study things. It looked at a leaf for a long, long time. "Hmm, interesting," it said. It looked at a raindrop. "Fascinating!" It looked at a little girl's shoe. "Very curious indeed." The little girl giggled. "You're like a tiny scientist!" Blipbug wiggled its hairs. It liked being called a scientist.

Dottler was a little bug Pokémon that stayed inside its round shell almost all the time. Inside, it was thinking and learning, getting smarter every day.

Dottler could sense what was happening outside, even without looking. It knew when the sun came up and when the rain started. It knew when its friends were coming to visit. Knock, knock. "Come in!" said Dottler, before they even said hello. "How did you know it was us?" they asked. Dottler just smiled inside its shell.

Orbeetle was a very smart bug Pokémon with a round shell full of psychic power. It could sense everything happening around it, for miles and miles.

Orbeetle floated above the forest, watching over everything. It knew where every Pokémon was and what they were doing. When a little Blipbug got lost, Orbeetle found it right away. When a storm was coming, Orbeetle warned everyone. "Get inside! Rain is coming!" Thanks to Orbeetle, the forest was always safe and ready.

Nickit was a little fox Pokémon that was very sneaky. It loved to sneak around without anyone noticing. And when it walked, it brushed away its footprints with its fluffy tail, so nobody could follow it!

Nickit liked to play hide-and-seek. It hid behind a bush and swept its tail over its tracks. Swish, swish! "Where's Nickit?" asked its friends. They looked everywhere. No footprints! No clues! Then they heard a little giggle from the bush. "Found you!" Nickit came out, laughing. It was the trickiest hider in the forest.

Thievul was a sly fox Pokémon with a long, fluffy tail and a mischievous grin. It liked to sneak around at night, very quietly, and it was very clever.

Thievul liked to leave little marks on trees to show where it had been. A little scratch here. A little scratch there. The children in the village liked to find the marks and follow them. "Thievul was here!" they whispered. One day, they followed the marks all the way to a hidden meadow full of wildflowers. Thievul was waiting there, grinning. It had wanted to share its secret.

Gossifleur was a little flower Pokémon that spun around and around, like a top. Whirrrr! When it spun, pollen floated out of its flower.

Gossifleur's pollen was special. Anyone who breathed it in felt fresh and healthy. Sniff! "Ahh, I feel great!" The old people in the village liked to sit in the meadow where Gossifleur spun. They breathed in the fresh air and felt young again. Gossifleur spun and spun, happy to share its pollen with everyone.

Eldegoss was a fluffy Pokémon with soft cotton puffs on its head. The cotton was full of seeds, and when the wind blew, the seeds floated away.

Eldegoss's cotton seeds were very special. They were full of goodness, and people used them to make soft, cozy clothes and blankets. When the wind blew, Eldegoss let its seeds float across the land. Puff, puff, puff! Wherever they landed, new plants grew. And Eldegoss grew new cotton, ready for the next breeze.

Wooloo was a little sheep Pokémon with thick, fluffy white wool. It was so fluffy that it looked like a little cloud with legs!

Wooloo didn't like fighting at all. When something scared it, it just curled up into a ball and rolled away. Roll, roll, roll! Its wool was so thick and bouncy that it could roll down a hill without getting hurt. Boing, boing! The children loved to watch the Wooloo roll down the hills in the spring. It looked like a parade of fluffy clouds.

Dubwool was a sheep Pokémon with very thick, very warm wool and two curly horns. Its wool was the warmest wool in the whole land.

Every spring, Dubwool's wool was trimmed, and people made it into blankets and sweaters. Snip, snip, snip! The blankets were so warm and soft that people slept better than ever. "Thank you, Dubwool!" they said. Dubwool shook itself happily. Its wool would grow back by next spring, ready to keep everyone warm again.

Chewtle was a little turtle Pokémon that loved to chomp. It chomped on everything to find out what it was. Chomp! A stick. Chomp! A leaf. Chomp! A shoelace!

Chewtle's teeth grew all the time, so it had to chomp to keep them from growing too long. Its friends gave it special sticks to chew on. "Chomp on these, Chewtle!" Chomp, chomp, chomp! Chewtle was very happy. But sometimes, it still chomped on a shoelace, just for fun.

Drednaw was a big turtle Pokémon with a strong shell and powerful jaws. It lived in rivers and lakes, and it was the strongest Pokémon in the water.

Drednaw had a long neck that could stretch out very far. It used it to reach the tastiest plants at the bottom of the lake. Stretch, chomp! The little Pokémon liked to sit on Drednaw's big shell while it floated in the lake. It was like a little island. And Drednaw floated slowly, carrying its friends around the lake.

Yamper was a little puppy Pokémon with a tail that made electricity. When it ran, its tail sparked and crackled! Zap, zap, zap!

Yamper helped the farmers look after the sheep. It ran around the field, barking and wagging its sparky tail. Woof! Zap! The Wooloo followed it back to the barn, all in a line. At the end of the day, the farmer gave Yamper a treat. Yamper wagged its tail so hard that it made a little shower of sparks. Zap, zap, happy!

Boltund was a fast dog Pokémon with electricity in its legs. When it ran, it went as fast as lightning! Zoom! Crackle!

Boltund loved to run. It ran across fields, along beaches and through forests. It ran for hours and never got tired. The children tried to race it. "Ready, set, go!" Zoom! Boltund was already at the end of the field, wagging its tail and waiting. "No fair!" the children laughed. But Boltund just barked happily. Woof! Let's go again!

Rolycoly was a little round Pokémon made of coal. It rolled around like a wheel, and it had a warm, glowing eye.

Rolycoly lived in the old coal mines, rolling through the tunnels. Roll, roll, roll! When the miners got cold, Rolycoly rolled up beside them and glowed warm. "Ahh, thank you, Rolycoly!" The miners warmed their hands. Rolycoly blinked its glowing eye happily. It liked being the warmest friend in the mine.

Carkol was a coal Pokémon that looked like a little mine cart. It burned coal inside its body to stay warm, and it rolled along on wheels.

Carkol liked to help the miners carry coal. It filled itself up, rolled out of the mine and dumped the coal into a big pile. Then it rolled back in for more. Roll, fill, roll, dump! At the end of the day, the miners sat around Carkol's warm glow and ate their dinner. Carkol was happy to help.

Coalossal was a giant Pokémon made of coal, as big as a small mountain. Its body glowed with fire, and it was warm all the way through.

Long ago, people in the cold north relied on Coalossal to keep them warm in the winter. It sat in the middle of the village, glowing like a big bonfire. Everyone gathered around it, warming their hands and telling stories. "Coalossal is our guardian," they said. And Coalossal glowed brighter, happy to keep them warm.

Applin was a tiny dragon Pokémon that lived inside an apple! It made the apple its home and peeked out from a little hole in the side.

Applin was very small and very shy. It stayed inside its apple most of the time, safe and snug. Sometimes, children picked up its apple, thinking it was just an apple. "What a nice apple!" Then Applin peeked out. "Hello!" The children squealed with surprise. Applin giggled. It was the best surprise in the orchard.

Flapple was a little dragon Pokémon that lived in an apple and used the apple skin as wings! It flew through the orchard, flapping its apple wings.

Flapple loved flying from tree to tree, looking for the sweetest apples. Flap, flap, flap! When it found a good one, it landed and munched. Crunch! Then it flew off to find another. The children in the orchard waved at it. "Hi, Flapple!" Flapple did a little loop in the air, flapping its apple wings, and zoomed away.

Appletun was a big, gentle dragon Pokémon that looked like a giant apple pie. Its back was covered in sweet, sticky nectar that smelled just like apple pie!

Appletun smelled so delicious that children followed it everywhere. Sniff, sniff! "Mmm, apple pie!" Appletun didn't mind. It walked slowly through the village, and everyone it passed felt hungry and happy. At the end of the day, the village baker made real apple pies, and everyone shared them with Appletun. It was the sweetest day ever.
