Silicobra was a sand snake Pokémon that lived in the desert. It had a little pouch around its neck where it stored sand.

Silicobra liked to burrow in the sand and play. Wiggle, wiggle, dig! When it popped out, it puffed sand from its pouch, like a little sand cloud. Poof! Its friends giggled and played in the sand cloud. "Again, Silicobra!" Poof! It made sand clouds all day long, until the sun went down and the desert cooled.

Sandaconda was a long sand snake Pokémon that could store lots and lots of sand in its body. When it coiled up, it looked like a big, round spring.

Sandaconda liked to coil up and then bounce, boing, like a giant spring! Boing, boing, boing! It bounced across the desert, leaving little puffs of sand behind it. The desert Pokémon thought it was the funniest thing they had ever seen. "Bounce higher, Sandaconda!" And Sandaconda bounced so high that it could see over the tallest sand dune.

Cramorant was a big blue bird Pokémon with a huge throat. It was a little bit silly, and it often swallowed things by mistake!

When Cramorant dove into the sea to catch fish, it sometimes caught an Arrokuda in its throat by accident. Gulp! Then it flew around with the Arrokuda sticking out of its mouth, looking very confused. "Hmm?" The Arrokuda looked confused too. The children on the beach laughed and laughed. Cramorant blinked, spat out the Arrokuda and dove right back in.

Arrokuda was a fast, pointy fish Pokémon that zipped through the water. It had a long, sharp jaw, and it could swim very, very fast.

Arrokuda liked to race the other fish. Zip! It always won. But sometimes, when it was swimming near the surface, a Cramorant swooped down and, gulp, caught it in its throat by mistake! Arrokuda sighed. It happened a lot. But it always got spat back out into the water, and then it went right back to racing.

Barraskewda was a long, pointy fish Pokémon that could swim incredibly fast. It spun its tail fin like a propeller and zoomed through the water like a rocket!

Barraskewda was the fastest swimmer in the sea. Zoom! The other fish could hardly see it pass by. When the fishermen's boats raced across the waves, Barraskewda raced alongside them. Zoom, zoom! It always won. Then it did a big jump out of the water and splashed back down, as if to say, "Try again tomorrow!"

Toxel was a little baby Pokémon that stored electricity and poison in its body. It was very small and very cute, and it cried a lot, like all babies do.

When Toxel cried, little sparks crackled around it. Waaah! Bzzt! Its family picked it up and rocked it gently. "Shh, shh, it's okay," they said. Slowly, Toxel stopped crying, and the sparks went quiet. Then it smiled a big, gummy smile and fell asleep. Babies need lots of cuddles, even sparky ones.

Toxtricity was a rock star Pokémon! It had bumps on its chest that it strummed like a guitar, and it made the coolest electric music. Twang, zap, twang!

When Toxtricity played, the crowd went wild. Twang, twang, ZAP! It jumped and danced and strummed, and electric sparks flew everywhere like fireworks. The children at the concert jumped up and down, cheering. "Toxtricity! Toxtricity!" At the end of the show, Toxtricity strummed one last chord and took a big bow.

Sizzlipede was a little orange bug Pokémon with a very warm body. It was so warm that it could warm up a whole room!

Sizzlipede curled up in a ball when it was happy, and it glowed warm and orange. On cold winter nights, the family put Sizzlipede in the middle of the room, and everyone gathered around. "Ahh, so cozy," they said. Sizzlipede glowed a little brighter, happy to keep them warm.

Centiskorch was a long, fiery bug Pokémon with lots of legs and a very hot body. It glowed orange and red, like a long, flickering fire.

Centiskorch could curl its long body into a circle, like a ring of fire. On the coldest night of the year, it curled up in the middle of the village square. The villagers gathered around it, roasting marshmallows and singing songs. "Centiskorch is the best campfire!" they said. And Centiskorch glowed happily all night long.

Clobbopus was a little orange octopus Pokémon that was very curious. It wanted to learn about everything, and it explored by tapping things with its tentacles. Tap, tap, tap!

Clobbopus tapped a rock. "Hard!" It tapped a leaf. "Soft!" It tapped a jellyfish. "Squishy!" It tapped its friend. "Hey!" laughed its friend. Clobbopus learned something new every day. And at night, it lay on the beach, thinking about all the things it had tapped.

Grapploct was a big octopus Pokémon with strong tentacles. It was very good at grappling and holding on, and it could hold onto anything, no matter how slippery.

Grapploct helped the fishermen. When their nets got stuck on rocks at the bottom of the sea, Grapploct swam down and untangled them. When their boats drifted away, Grapploct grabbed the ropes and pulled them back. "Thanks, Grapploct!" said the fishermen. Grapploct waved all eight of its tentacles. It liked being helpful.

Sinistea was a little ghost Pokémon that lived inside an old teacup. It was very shy and liked quiet places, like old tea shops and dusty cupboards.

Sometimes, Sinistea floated out of its teacup and swirled around the room, like steam from a cup of hot tea. The shop owner saw it once and smiled. "Ah, my little teacup ghost," she said. She made it a fresh cup of tea every morning. And Sinistea floated in the warm steam, happy and cozy.

Polteageist was a ghost Pokémon that lived inside an old teapot. It floated around, pouring itself out like tea, and it smelled like a warm, cozy kitchen.

Polteageist liked to visit the tea shop in the village. When customers came in, it floated near their cups and poured a little bit of its warm, sweet-smelling tea. "Mmm, this tea is delicious!" they said. They never knew a ghost had poured it! Polteageist floated back to its shelf, giggling quietly.

Hatenna was a little pink Pokémon that could feel other people's feelings. It didn't like strong feelings at all, like anger or loud noise, and it hid when people were upset.

Hatenna liked calm, quiet places. When people were peaceful and happy, Hatenna came close and sat with them. When a little girl was sitting quietly, reading a book, Hatenna floated over and sat on her lap. She stroked its soft head. Hatenna closed its eyes and felt calm and happy too.

Hattrem was a pink Pokémon with a big braid of hair. It liked peace and quiet more than anything, and it didn't like anyone being too loud or too upset.

When people got too noisy, Hattrem used its braid to shoo them away. Swish! "Shh, please," it seemed to say. But when people were calm and happy, Hattrem loved them. It sat with them in the quiet meadow, and they all enjoyed the peace and quiet together. Ahh.

Hatterene was a tall pink Pokémon with a big, witchy hat. It lived deep in a quiet forest, where it was always peaceful.

Hatterene could feel feelings from very far away. When people in the forest were calm and kind, Hatterene glowed softly. When people were too noisy, it hid behind the trees. People called it the forest witch. But Hatterene wasn't scary at all. It just liked peace and quiet. And if you visit its forest quietly, it might just say hello.

Impidimp was a little imp Pokémon with pink hair. It was full of mischief and loved to play little pranks on everyone.

Impidimp hid behind doors and said, "Boo!" It tied people's shoelaces together. It hid the cookies and put a leaf in the cookie jar. Its friends rolled their eyes. "Impidimp!" But then Impidimp gave everyone the cookies back, giggling. "Just kidding!" And they couldn't help laughing too.

Morgrem was a sneaky Pokémon that liked to play tricks. It would pretend to be sad, and then, when someone came to help, it jumped up and laughed. "Tricked you!"

Morgrem thought its tricks were very funny. But one day, a little Wooloo really was hurt, and nobody believed it. "Morgrem is just tricking us," they said. Morgrem felt bad. So it ran to help the Wooloo and told everyone the truth. After that, Morgrem only played tricks that were kind.

Grimmsnarl was a big Pokémon with long hair that wrapped around its body like muscles. Its hair was so strong that it could lift heavy things.

Grimmsnarl looked very scary, but it liked to help. It used its strong hair to lift fallen trees off the road. Heave! It carried heavy bags for old people. Heave! It even gave the children rides on its shoulders. Wheee! "You're not scary at all, Grimmsnarl!" they said. Grimmsnarl grinned its big, toothy grin.

Obstagoon was a big Pokémon with a long tongue and a loud voice. When it wanted to show everyone how tough it was, it crossed its arms in an X shape and shouted!

Obstagoon was the loudest Pokémon in town. "WOOOO!" it shouted. But it wasn't trying to be scary. It was cheering! When the town's football team scored a goal, Obstagoon crossed its arms and shouted, "WOOOO!" Everyone else cheered too. Obstagoon was the best cheerleader in town.

Perrserker was a tough cat Pokémon with a helmet of metal on its head. It came from Meowth that lived with brave sailors long, long ago.

Perrserker was very proud of its metal helmet. It polished it every day until it shone. Shine, shine! It liked to tell stories about the old sailing days, when its ancestors sailed across the sea on big ships. "We were brave and strong!" it said. The little Meowth listened with wide eyes, dreaming of adventure.

Cursola was a ghost Pokémon made of white coral. Long ago, it was a colorful coral Pokémon, but the seas changed, and now it was pale and white.

Cursola remembered the warm, colorful seas from long ago. It liked to float near the bottom of the ocean, thinking about the old days. The little fish Pokémon came to visit it. "Tell us about the colorful seas," they said. And Cursola told them stories of pink and orange coral, warm water and sunshine. The little fish listened, and they promised to keep their seas clean and colorful.

Sirfetch’d was a brave duck Pokémon that carried a long leek like a sword and a big leaf like a shield. It was like a knight from the old stories.

Sirfetch’d was very brave and very proud. It protected the little Pokémon in its village, standing tall with its leek sword and leaf shield. When the young Farfetch’d came to learn, Sirfetch’d taught them how to hold their leeks properly. "Stand tall," it said. "Be brave. And always help those who need it."

Mr. Rime was a funny Pokémon that loved to tap dance. It wore a little hat and carried a cane, and it tapped its feet on the ice. Tap, tap, tappity-tap!

Mr. Rime was a comedian. It did silly dances and funny faces to make everyone laugh. When it slipped on the ice, it pretended it was part of the dance. Whoops, tap, tap, ta-da! The children laughed until their sides hurt. "Do it again, Mr. Rime!" And Mr. Rime did, slipping and tapping and twirling across the ice.

Runerigus was a ghost Pokémon that looked like an old stone tablet with ancient drawings on it. It was very old and very mysterious.

Runerigus wandered through the old ruins, carrying its stone tablet. The drawings on the tablet told stories from long, long ago. When explorers came to the ruins, Runerigus let them look at the drawings. "What do they mean?" the explorers asked. Runerigus didn't say. But the explorers studied the drawings for hours, trying to understand the ancient stories.

Milcery was a little Pokémon made of sweet, fluffy cream. It smelled so sweet that people loved having it in their kitchens.

Milcery liked to help bakers. When they made cakes and cookies, Milcery floated nearby, and its sweet smell made everything taste even better. Yum! The bakers loved Milcery. "Our cakes are the best because of you!" they said. Milcery swirled happily, making its cream even fluffier.

Alcremie was a sweet Pokémon made of cream, and it decorated itself with little treats like strawberries, berries and flowers. It looked just like a beautiful cake!

When Alcremie was happy, it spun around, and its cream got even sweeter. Spin, spin! It shared its sweet cream with people who were sad. "Here," it said, giving them a little bit. Taste! "Mmm, delicious!" Their sadness melted away. Every Alcremie was decorated differently, and each one was as sweet as could be.

Falinks was six little Pokémon that marched together in a line, like soldiers. One was the leader, and the other five followed it everywhere. Hup, two, three, four!

The Falinks practiced marching every day. They marched in a line. They marched in a circle. They marched in a triangle! "Formation!" said the leader. And all six moved together perfectly. The children watched and marched along. "Hup, two, three, four!" Soon, there was a whole parade marching through the village.

Pincurchin was a little round sea urchin Pokémon covered in spiky spines. Its spines crackled with electricity, and it lived among the rocks at the bottom of the sea.

Pincurchin liked to munch on seaweed. Nibble, nibble! It scraped the seaweed off the rocks with its little teeth. When the fish Pokémon swam by, Pincurchin's spines glowed and crackled. Zap! They kept a little distance, but they waved hello. Pincurchin waved back with its spines. It was a friendly, sparkly little sea urchin.

Snom was a tiny white bug Pokémon that ate snow. It loved to munch on the fresh snow that fell on the ground. Munch, munch, crunch!

Snom was so small that it was hard to see in the snow. It wiggled through the snowdrifts, munching away. When the children built snowmen, Snom sometimes nibbled a little bit of the snowman! "Hey, my snowman's nose is gone!" said a little boy. Snom giggled and wiggled away, its tummy full of snow.

Frosmoth was a beautiful moth Pokémon with icy wings that shimmered like frost. When it flew, little snowflakes drifted down from its wings.

Frosmoth flew over the snowy fields at night, scattering sparkly snowflakes. Glitter, glitter! The snow sparkled like diamonds in the moonlight. The children in the village looked out their windows. "Look, it's snowing glitter!" Frosmoth danced in the moonlight, and everyone felt like they were living in a snow globe.

Stonjourner was a big Pokémon made of stone, shaped like a giant rock pillar. Once a year, all the Stonjourner gathered together in a big circle.

Nobody knew why the Stonjourner gathered in a circle. Maybe they were having a meeting. Maybe they were watching the sunrise. Maybe they were just saying hello. The people in the village came to watch. They saw the giant stones standing in a circle as the sun came up. It was very quiet and very peaceful, and everyone felt something special.

Eiscue was a penguin Pokémon with a big ice cube on its head! The ice cube kept its head cool, because Eiscue didn't like being warm.

Eiscue loved the cold. It swam in the icy sea and slid on the frozen ice. Wheee! When the sun came out and it got warm, Eiscue's ice cube started to melt. "Oh no!" It hurried into the cold water to make a new one. Splash! When it came out, it had a brand-new ice cube on its head, all fresh and cold. Ahh!

Indeedee was a polite Pokémon that loved to help people. It could feel other people's feelings, and it always knew what they needed.

Indeedee worked at a fancy hotel, helping the guests. When someone was tired, Indeedee brought them a cup of tea. When someone was sad, it brought them a cookie. When someone was lost, it showed them the way. "Thank you, Indeedee!" said the guests. Indeedee bowed politely. It was the best helper in the whole hotel.

Morpeko was a little hamster Pokémon that was always, always hungry. When it was full, it was happy and sweet. But when it got hungry, it got very grumpy!

When Morpeko was full, its fur was yellow, and it smiled and played. But when it got hungry, its fur turned dark, and it scowled. "Grr! I'm hungry!" Its friends always kept seeds in their pockets for Morpeko. When it got grumpy, they gave it a snack. Munch, munch! And Morpeko's fur turned yellow again, and it smiled.

Cufant was a little copper elephant Pokémon, and it was very strong for its size. It could lift things that were much heavier than itself!

Cufant liked to help the builders in town. It lifted heavy beams with its trunk and carried them to where they needed to go. Heave, ho! The builders were amazed. "Cufant, you're so strong!" Cufant trumpeted happily. Toot! It liked being helpful, and it liked being strong.

Copperajah was a big copper elephant Pokémon. Its skin was made of copper, and it was shiny and green in some places. It was very strong and very gentle.

Long ago, Copperajah came from a faraway land, and it helped people build towns and bridges. It carried heavy stones with its strong trunk. Heave! Now, it lived in the town park, and the children came to play with it. They slid down its trunk and rode on its back. Wheee! Copperajah trumpeted happily. Toot, toot!

Dracozolt was a funny-looking ancient Pokémon. Its top half came from one ancient Pokémon and its bottom half from another! It looked a little strange, but it was full of energy.

Dracozolt's legs were very strong, and it could run very fast. But its arms were very tiny! It tried to pick up a berry. Reach, reach! Its tiny arms couldn't reach. So it used its tail instead. Swish! Got it! Dracozolt was very good at finding new ways to do things.

Arctozolt was a funny ancient Pokémon made from two different fossils. Its top half was icy and cold, and its bottom half was electric. It shivered all the time!

Arctozolt shivered and shook. Brrr! Its icy top half made it cold, but its electric bottom half made it buzzy. Bzzt! The children thought it was funny. They brought it a warm blanket. "Here, Arctozolt." Arctozolt snuggled into the blanket and stopped shivering. It smiled a big, icy smile.

Dracovish was an ancient Pokémon made from two different fossils. It had a fish's head and a dragon's legs, so it looked very funny. But it was also very fast!

Dracovish could run very fast on its strong legs. Zoom! But its fish head liked to be in the water. So it ran to the river, dipped its head in, splash, and then ran off again. Zoom! The children laughed. "Dracovish, you're so silly!" Dracovish blinked its fish eyes. It didn't think it was silly at all.

Arctovish was an ancient Pokémon made from two fossils. It had an icy fish face and a body that was not very good at moving. It could swim well, but on land, it wobbled!

Arctovish liked the cold water best. It swam in the icy sea, wiggling its fins. Swish, swish! When it came onto land, it wobbled around. Wobble, wobble, flop! The children helped it back into the water. "There you go, Arctovish!" Arctovish smiled and swam away, happy to be home.

Duraludon was a tall Pokémon made of strong, shiny metal. It looked a bit like a tall building, and it was very hard and very strong.

Duraludon liked to stand tall in the city, among the buildings. People sometimes mistook it for a building! "What a strange building," they said. Then Duraludon blinked. "Hello!" The people jumped. Then they laughed. "You're not a building at all!" Duraludon smiled. It liked being the friendliest building in town.

Dreepy was a tiny ghost dragon Pokémon. It was so small that it lived inside the horn of a big Dragapult, like a little passenger!

Dreepy loved riding in Dragapult's horn. Whoosh! They flew through the sky together, and Dreepy looked out at the world, wide-eyed. When they landed, Dreepy floated out and played with its friends. But when it got tired, it zoomed right back into its cozy horn. "Ahh, home," it sighed, and fell asleep.

Drakloak was a ghost dragon Pokémon that took good care of the little Dreepy. It let them ride on its head, like a big brother or sister.

Drakloak flew around with a Dreepy on its head. Whoosh! The little Dreepy giggled and held on tight. When it was hungry, Drakloak found it food. When it was tired, Drakloak found a quiet place to rest. "Thank you, Drakloak!" said the little Dreepy. Drakloak smiled. It liked being the big one.

Dragapult was a big ghost dragon Pokémon with horns on its head. And inside its horns lived the little Dreepy, snug and safe!

Dragapult could fly very, very fast. Zoom! The little Dreepy loved riding in its horns, feeling the wind rush by. When they stopped to rest, Dragapult let the Dreepy out to play. "Have fun!" it said. And when it was time to go, all the Dreepy zoomed back into its horns. "All aboard?" Dragapult asked. "All aboard!" they cheered. Whoosh!

Zacian was a legendary Pokémon, a beautiful blue wolf with a golden sword in its mouth. Long ago, it was a hero that saved the land.

People told a story about Zacian. Long, long ago, when the land was in danger, Zacian appeared with its golden sword. It was brave and fast, and it protected everyone. After the danger was gone, Zacian went to sleep in a quiet forest. People say it still watches over the land today, ready to help if it's ever needed.

Zamazenta was a legendary Pokémon, a strong red wolf with a golden shield. Long ago, it was a hero that protected the land.

People told a story about Zamazenta. Long, long ago, when the land was in danger, Zamazenta appeared with its golden shield. Nothing could get past it. It stood strong and protected everyone. After the danger was gone, Zamazenta went to sleep alongside Zacian in the quiet forest. Together, the sword and the shield watch over the land.

Eternatus was a giant legendary Pokémon that came from space. It fell to the earth long, long ago, inside a meteor, and it was full of strange, powerful energy.

Eternatus was so big and so powerful that people were a bit scared of it. But it was just lonely, so far from home. It floated in the sky, glowing red, looking up at the stars. "Where is my home?" it wondered. Maybe someday it will find its way back. Until then, it watches the stars every night.

Kubfu was a little bear Pokémon that practiced martial arts every day. It wanted to be strong and brave, and it never stopped training.

Kubfu practiced its punches. Hi-yah! It practiced its kicks. Hi-yah! It practiced its balance, standing on one foot for a long, long time. Its teacher watched proudly. "Good job, Kubfu," he said. "Keep practicing." Kubfu bowed. "I will, Master!" And it practiced even harder the next day.

Urshifu was a strong bear Pokémon that had mastered the martial arts. It had trained for years and years, climbing tall towers and practicing every day.

Urshifu was very wise. It taught the young Kubfu everything it knew. "Strength comes from practice," it said. "And from a calm heart." The little Kubfu listened carefully. They practiced together in the mountains, from sunrise to sunset. And Urshifu was proud of every single one of them.

Zarude was a Mythical Pokémon that lived deep in the jungle. It could grow vines from its arms and swing through the trees. Swing, swing, swing!

Zarude knew every tree and every vine in the jungle. It swung from tree to tree, faster than anyone. It watched over the jungle, making sure everything was healthy and green. And sometimes, when the little jungle Pokémon were lost, Zarude swung down and carried them home, gently, on its back.

Regieleki was a legendary Pokémon made of pure electricity. It could zoom around faster than any other Pokémon in the world! Zoom!

Regieleki was so fast that it was hard to see. Zip! It was here. Zip! It was there. Long ago, people built a special place to keep Regieleki safe, because it had so much energy. Now, it zooms around its home, crackling and sparkling. If you see a flash of yellow light zipping by, it might be Regieleki, having fun.

Regidrago was a legendary Pokémon shaped like a dragon's head. It was made of dragon energy, and it was very mysterious and very old.

Long, long ago, people made Regidrago to look like a dragon. It slept for thousands of years in an old temple. When it finally woke up, it looked around with its glowing eyes. Everything had changed! But Regidrago was patient. It sat quietly in its temple, watching the world, getting used to its new home.

Glastrier was a legendary horse Pokémon made of ice. Its mane was made of icicles, and it breathed out cold, frosty air.

Glastrier lived in the snowy mountains, where it was always cold. It galloped across the snow, leaving icy footprints behind it. Clip, clop, crack! The children of the snowy village loved to follow its footprints. "Look, Glastrier was here!" They followed the icy trail until it disappeared into the snowy mountains.

Spectrier was a legendary ghost horse Pokémon with a dark mane that flowed like smoke. It could gallop through the night, quiet as a shadow.

Spectrier liked to gallop under the stars. Its dark mane glowed faintly in the moonlight. When the village children looked out their windows at night, they sometimes saw a shadowy horse galloping across the hills. "Spectrier!" they whispered. It looked back at them, then galloped away into the dark.

Calyrex was a legendary Pokémon, the king of plants and harvests. Long ago, it ruled the land and made the crops grow big and strong.

Calyrex had a big flower-shaped head, and it could make plants grow just by touching them. When the farmers needed help, Calyrex visited their fields. The carrots grew big and orange. The pumpkins grew round and fat. "Thank you, King Calyrex!" said the farmers. Calyrex smiled. A good harvest made everyone happy.

Wyrdeer was a big deer Pokémon with huge, curly antlers and a fluffy beard. Long, long ago, people in the old land rode on Wyrdeer to cross the snowy fields.

Wyrdeer's antlers could make strange, shimmering pictures in the air. It walked through the snowy meadows, and the air around its antlers shimmered like a rainbow. People rode on its back, bundled up in their warm coats, and Wyrdeer carried them home through the snow, step by step.

Kleavor was a bug Pokémon from long ago, with big stone axes on its arms. It used its axes to chop wood and carve stone.

Kleavor lived in a forest of tall trees. It was very good at carving. It carved little statues out of stone: a little Pidgey, a little Pikachu, a little Wooloo. People came from far away to see Kleavor's carvings. "They're beautiful!" they said. Kleavor bowed. It liked making beautiful things.

Ursaluna was a big bear Pokémon with a strong body. It lived in the old land, long ago, and it could find rich soil just by sniffing the ground.

Ursaluna dug in the earth with its big paws, looking for peat, a special kind of soil. Dig, dig, dig! It had a mark on its forehead shaped like the full moon, and on full-moon nights, it felt especially strong. The farmers loved Ursaluna, because wherever it dug, the soil was rich and good for growing.

Basculegion was a big fish Pokémon from long ago, with a ghostly glow. It swam through the rivers of the old land, watching over the smaller fish.

Basculegion was strong and fast, and it took care of the little Basculin in its river. When the river was fast and rough, Basculegion swam in front, making a path for the little ones. "Follow me!" it called. And the little Basculin followed it all the way up the river, safe and sound.

Sneasler was a Pokémon from long ago that was very good at climbing. It could climb up cliffs and mountains with its sharp claws, faster than anyone.

Sneasler lived in the mountains of the old land. It climbed up the tallest cliffs, all the way to the top, just to see the view. "Wow!" When people were lost in the mountains, Sneasler climbed up high, looked around and showed them the way home. "This way!" it called from the top of a cliff.

Overqwil was a spiky fish Pokémon from long ago. It was covered in long spikes, and it puffed up when it was surprised. Puff!

Overqwil swam through the sea of the old land, puffed up and spiky. The other fish kept a little distance. "Too spiky!" they said. But Overqwil was friendly. It slowly let out its air, pfffft, and its spikes lay flat. "See? I'm not so spiky," it said. And the other fish came closer to play.

Enamorus was a legendary Pokémon that came with the spring. When it flew across the land, the flowers bloomed, the birds sang and everyone felt love and happiness.

Every spring, Enamorus flew over the old land, bringing warmth after the long, cold winter. The snow melted, the grass turned green and the flowers bloomed in every color. The people came out of their houses, smiling and hugging each other. "Spring is here!" they said. And Enamorus flew on, spreading love wherever it went.

Sprigatito was a little green kitten Pokémon with fur that smelled sweet, like fresh grass and flowers. When people smelled it, they felt calm and happy.

Sprigatito loved attention. It rubbed against people's legs and purred. Purr, purr! When it kneaded its paws on a soft blanket, the sweet smell got even stronger. Knead, knead. Everyone wanted to pet Sprigatito. "You smell so nice!" they said. Sprigatito purred louder. It knew exactly how to make everyone love it.

Floragato was a graceful cat Pokémon with a flower bud hidden in its fur. It was very agile and could leap and twirl like an acrobat.

Floragato practiced its tricks every day. It leaped from tree to tree. It flipped in the air. It landed perfectly on a branch, light as a feather. Swish, flip, land! The children clapped. "Floragato, you're amazing!" Floragato bowed, its tail swishing. Then it did one more flip, just for fun.

Meowscarada was a magical cat Pokémon that loved to do magic tricks. It had a flowery cape and could make flowers appear out of nowhere!

Meowscarada performed magic shows for the children in town. "Watch carefully!" Swish! A flower appeared in its paw. Swish! Now it was gone! Swish! It was behind a little girl's ear! "Wow!" the children gasped. Meowscarada bowed and threw flower petals into the air. Everyone cheered. It was the best magic show in the world.

Fuecoco was a little red crocodile Pokémon that loved to eat. It was very relaxed and easygoing, and it never worried about anything except where its next snack was coming from.

Fuecoco walked around slowly, looking for food. Munch, munch, munch! When it found something tasty, it smiled and ate it all. Then it lay down in the sun for a nap. Zzz. Its friends said, "Fuecoco, don't you want to do anything else?" Fuecoco thought about it. "Maybe a snack," it said. And everyone laughed.

Crocalor was a crocodile Pokémon with a big ball of fire on its head, shaped like a little bird's nest. It was full of energy and loved to play.

Crocalor's fire nest glowed bright and warm. The little bird Pokémon liked to sit on it to warm their feathers on chilly mornings. "Ahh, so cozy!" Crocalor didn't mind. It walked carefully, so its little passengers wouldn't fall off. Step, step, step. It liked being a warm, cozy home for its friends.

Skeledirge was a big fire Pokémon with a little fire bird sitting on its head. When Skeledirge sang, the little bird sang along, and their voices were warm and soothing.

Skeledirge's songs were so gentle that everyone who heard them felt calm and peaceful. When the children couldn't sleep, Skeledirge sang them a lullaby. La, la, la... The little fire bird on its head glowed softly, like a candle. One by one, the children's eyes closed. And Skeledirge sang on, softly, until everyone was asleep.

Quaxly was a little duck Pokémon that liked to be very neat and tidy. Its head feathers were slick and shiny, and they never got wet, even in the rain.

Quaxly cleaned its feathers every morning. It washed its face. It tidied its nest. "Everything must be neat!" it said. When its friends came to visit, Quaxly made sure they wiped their feet. "Thank you!" it said. Its friends laughed. Quaxly was a little fussy, but it had the cleanest nest in the whole pond.

Quaxwell was a duck Pokémon that loved to dance. It practiced its dance steps every single day, getting better and better.

Quaxwell danced in the water. It danced on the shore. It danced on the lily pads. Kick, step, spin! Sometimes it fell over. Splash! But it got right back up and tried again. "Practice makes perfect!" it said. And one day, Quaxwell danced so beautifully that all the other Pokémon stopped to watch and cheer.

Quaquaval was a tall, colorful duck Pokémon with feathers that looked like a fancy costume. It was the best dancer in the whole land!

Quaquaval danced at every festival. Its feathers swirled and its feet tapped and it spun around and around. Cha-cha-cha! The crowd cheered and clapped. Then Quaquaval invited everyone to dance with it. "Come on, everyone! Let's dance!" And the whole town danced together, laughing and spinning, until the stars came out.

Lechonk was a little pig Pokémon that loved to eat. It sniffed around for food all day long. Sniff, sniff, oink!

Lechonk lived in a big group with other Lechonk. They followed each other everywhere, in a long line. Oink, oink, oink! When one found food, all the others came running. They shared everything. "Oink!" said the first one. "Oink!" said the others. That meant, "Thank you!" They were the friendliest pigs in the whole village.

Oinkologne was a pig Pokémon that smelled wonderful, like flowers and perfume. It took great care of how it smelled and how it looked.

Oinkologne's lovely smell drifted through the whole village. Sniff! "Ahh, flowers!" said the villagers. But there weren't any flowers. It was Oinkologne! Oinkologne loved to visit people and make their homes smell nice. It walked through the house, and soon everything smelled like a garden. "Thank you, Oinkologne!" they said.

Tarountula was a little spider Pokémon that carried a ball of thread on its back. It used the thread to make things, like bridges between trees.

Tarountula was very busy. It spun thread to fix broken webs. It spun thread to tie up loose leaves. And it spun thread to make little bridges, so the other bug Pokémon could cross from tree to tree. "Thank you, Tarountula!" they said, walking across. Tarountula smiled and spun another bridge.

Spidops was a spider Pokémon that was very, very patient. It could sit still for hours, waiting quietly. It was the best at waiting.

When the children played freeze tag, Spidops was the champion. Nobody could stay still as long as Spidops. "Freeze!" they shouted. And Spidops froze. One minute. Ten minutes. An hour! The children got bored and went home for dinner. Spidops was still frozen. It was very proud of itself.

Nymble was a little grasshopper Pokémon with strong back legs. It could jump very high and very far. Boing! Boing! Boing!

Nymble loved jumping. It jumped over rocks. It jumped over streams. It jumped over its friends! "Wheee!" One day, Nymble jumped so high that it saw the whole meadow from above. It saw the flowers, the river and all its friends looking up at it. "Hello down there!" Then it landed with a soft boing.

Lokix was a grasshopper Pokémon with strong legs that could kick and jump very high. It was very cool and liked to strike poses.

Lokix practiced its kicks and jumps every day. Jump! Kick! Pose! When it landed, it stood very still and looked cool. "Ta-da!" The children copied it. Jump! Kick! Pose! They wobbled and fell over. Lokix laughed. "You'll get it!" And it showed them again, slowly, step by step.

Pawmi was a little orange mouse Pokémon with electric pads on its paws. It rubbed its cheeks to charge up its paws with electricity. Rub, rub, bzzt!

Pawmi was always ready to play. It ran around and around, its little paws crackling. Bzzt, bzzt! When it gave someone a high five, they got a tiny tingle. Zap! "Hee-hee!" they giggled. Pawmi giggled too. It loved giving high fives, and it loved the giggles even more.

Pawmo was a mouse Pokémon with electric paws. It was very energetic and loved to practice its punches, making little sparks fly. Pow! Bzzt! Pow! Bzzt!

Pawmo was always cheering on its friends. When a little Pawmi was trying to climb a tree, Pawmo cheered it on. "You can do it! Go, go, go!" It sparked its paws like little fireworks. Bzzt, bzzt! And when the Pawmi reached the top, Pawmo cheered the loudest of all.

Pawmot was a fluffy mouse Pokémon with an electric mane. It was strong and caring, and it always looked after its friends.

Pawmot's fur was so fluffy that it stood up like a puffball. When it hugged its friends, its fur crackled softly. Crackle, crackle! It didn't hurt. It just felt warm and tingly, like a cozy blanket. "Pawmot gives the best hugs," said its friends. And Pawmot hugged them all, one by one.

Tandemaus was two little mice that were always together. They held hands everywhere they went, and they never, ever let go.

The two mice shared everything. When one found a berry, it shared it with the other. When one was scared, the other held its hand tighter. When one was tired, they both took a nap. "We're a family," they said. And they walked through the meadow hand in hand, the best of friends forever.

Maushold was a family of little mice that lived together. They did everything together, like a big, happy family.

Every morning, the Maushold family went out together to look for food. They walked in a line, holding hands. Squeak, squeak, squeak! When they found berries, they shared them out equally. One for you, one for you, one for you. At night, they curled up together in a cozy pile and fell asleep, snuggled close.

Fidough was a little puppy Pokémon made of dough. Its body was soft and squishy, like bread before it goes into the oven.

Fidough smelled like warm bread, and everyone who smelled it got hungry. Sniff! "Mmm, bread!" Fidough loved to help the baker. It breathed on the dough, and the dough rose up, big and fluffy. Puff! "Thank you, Fidough!" said the baker. Fidough wagged its doughy tail. It liked being the best baker's helper in town.

Dachsbun was a puppy Pokémon that smelled like freshly baked bread. Its body was warm and toasty, and its fur was golden brown, like a perfect loaf.

Everyone loved Dachsbun because it smelled so good. When it walked through the village, people followed their noses. "Is someone baking bread?" No, it was just Dachsbun! The baker loved Dachsbun. It sat in the bakery window, and everyone who smelled it came in to buy bread. Dachsbun was the best advertisement in town.

Smoliv was a little olive Pokémon with a leaf on its head. It made a bitter-tasting oil that kept other Pokémon from eating it.

Smoliv liked to sit in the sun, soaking up the warm rays. Ahh. It didn't move very much. It just sat there, growing a little bit every day. When the farmers came by, they waved hello. "Grow big and strong, Smoliv!" Smoliv smiled. It was growing, slowly but surely.

Dolliv was an olive Pokémon with olives growing on its branches. It liked to share its olives with other Pokémon that needed food.

When the little Pokémon in the garden were hungry, Dolliv gave them its olives. "Here, have some!" The olives were tasty and full of goodness. The little Pokémon munched happily. "Thank you, Dolliv!" Dolliv was happy to share. Its olives always grew back, so there was always enough for everyone.

Arboliva was a big olive tree Pokémon. It made a special oil that was full of goodness, and it shared it with Pokémon and people who were weak or tired.

Arboliva was very kind. When a little Pokémon was sick, Arboliva gave it a few drops of its oil. "This will help you feel better," it said. And it did! The little Pokémon felt strong again. Arboliva watched over the garden, sharing its oil with anyone who needed it. It was the kindest tree in the whole land.

Squawkabilly was a colorful parrot Pokémon that lived in big, noisy groups. They loved to talk and squawk and chatter all day long!

The Squawkabilly sat on the rooftops of the town, squawking at each other. Squawk! Squawk! Chatter, chatter! They talked about the weather, the food and the people walking by. The people in town laughed. "Those Squawkabilly never stop talking!" And the Squawkabilly squawked back. "Never! Never!"

Nacli was a little Pokémon made of salt rocks. It was very small and very cute, and wherever it went, it left a little trail of salt.

Nacli liked to help the cooks in the kitchen. When they needed a pinch of salt, Nacli shook itself, and a little bit of salt fell into the pot. Sprinkle! "Perfect!" said the cooks. "Thank you, Nacli!" The soup was delicious. Nacli was the best salty helper in the whole kitchen.

Naclstack was a Pokémon made of salt bricks stacked on top of each other. It was strong and sturdy, like a little salt tower.

Naclstack made salt bricks and used them to build things. It built little walls around the garden. It built little houses for the small Pokémon. Stack, stack, stack! The walls were strong and pretty, sparkling white in the sun. "You're the best builder, Naclstack!" said its friends. Naclstack stacked one more brick, proudly.

Garganacl was a big, strong Pokémon made of salt. It was very kind and very caring, and it always looked after the people and Pokémon around it.

Long ago, people used Garganacl's salt to keep their food fresh. It traveled from village to village, sharing its salt with everyone. "Thank you, Garganacl!" they said. Garganacl smiled. It liked being helpful. And wherever it went, the people had plenty of food all winter long.

Charcadet was a little fire Pokémon that dreamed of wearing armor, like a brave knight. It practiced every day to be strong and brave.

Charcadet looked at the old armor in the museum and dreamed. "Someday, I'll be a knight," it said. It practiced its moves, its flame burning bright. Whoosh! Its friends cheered it on. "You'll be the bravest knight ever, Charcadet!" Charcadet's flame burned even brighter with happiness.

Armarouge was a brave knight Pokémon wearing shiny red and gold armor. It used to be a little Charcadet, and now its dream had come true!

Armarouge was very proud of its armor. It polished it every day until it shone like the sun. Shine, shine! It protected the little Pokémon in its town, standing tall and brave. When the children saw it, they cheered. "Armarouge, our hero!" Armarouge raised its arm in a salute. It was the bravest knight in the land.

Ceruledge was a knight Pokémon wearing dark blue armor, with blue flames flickering around it. It was quiet and mysterious, and it liked to walk alone.

Ceruledge wandered from place to place, looking for adventure. It didn't say much. But wherever it went, it helped people who needed it. It carried heavy loads for travelers. It lit campfires for lost hikers. Then it walked on, its blue flames glowing in the dark. "Who was that?" people wondered. Nobody knew. But they always remembered its kindness.

Tadbulb was a little tadpole Pokémon that looked like a lightbulb. When it was happy, it lit up bright yellow! Glow!

Tadbulb floated around the pond, glowing softly. At night, it was the brightest thing in the water. Glow, glow, glow! The fish Pokémon followed its light. "Tadbulb, you're like a little lamp!" they said. Tadbulb glowed even brighter. It loved being a light in the dark.

Bellibolt was a big, round frog Pokémon with a glowing belly. Its belly was like a big lightbulb, and it could light up a whole room!

When the power went out in town, the people brought Bellibolt to the town hall. It sat in the middle of the room and glowed. Glow! The whole room lit up, bright and warm. "Thank you, Bellibolt!" said the people. They played games and told stories in Bellibolt's warm glow until the power came back.

Wattrel was a little seabird Pokémon that could store electricity in its wings. It flew over the sea, gliding on the wind.

Wattrel liked to fly through thunderstorms. When lightning flashed, Wattrel soaked up a little bit of the electricity. Zap! Then it flew home with sparkly wings, buzzing with energy. Its friends watched it come home, glowing in the dark sky. "There's Wattrel!" they said. And Wattrel did a happy loop before landing.

Kilowattrel was a big seabird Pokémon that could fly very far by using the electricity stored in its wings. It could fly across the whole sea without stopping!

Kilowattrel loved to fly over the ocean, all the way to faraway islands. Whoosh! It soared over the waves, its wings crackling. When it reached a new island, it said hello to all the Pokémon there. "Hello! I've come from far away!" The island Pokémon were amazed. Then Kilowattrel flew home again, ready for its next adventure.

Maschiff was a little puppy Pokémon with a serious face. It was very brave, and it took its job of protecting its family very seriously.

Maschiff guarded the house all day. When strangers came by, it barked. Woof! Woof! But when its family came home, it wagged its tail so hard that its whole body wiggled. "Hello, Maschiff!" said the children. Maschiff jumped up and licked their faces. It was serious, but it was also very, very happy to see them.

Mabosstiff was a big, strong dog Pokémon with a serious face. It looked very tough, but it loved children more than anything.

Mabosstiff watched over the children in its family. It walked them to the park. It stood beside them when they played. And when they were tired, it let them lean against its big, warm side. "Mabosstiff is the best," said the children, snuggling close. Mabosstiff closed its eyes and wagged its tail. It loved its family very much.

Shroodle was a little mouse Pokémon that loved to paint. It used a special paint from its mouth to make colorful designs on rocks and leaves.

Shroodle painted swirls and dots and squiggles everywhere it went. Splat, splat! The forest was covered in its colorful art. The other Pokémon thought it was beautiful. "Shroodle, you're an artist!" they said. Shroodle smiled and painted a little heart on a leaf, just for them.

Grafaiai was a monkey Pokémon that was a very talented artist. It painted big, colorful pictures on trees and walls with its fingers.

Every Grafaiai had its own special style of painting. This one loved to paint flowers. It painted roses, daisies and sunflowers all over the old gray wall in the town square. The townspeople were amazed. "It's beautiful!" they said. Grafaiai bowed and signed its painting with a little paw print.

Bramblin was a little tumbleweed Pokémon that rolled wherever the wind blew it. Roll, roll, roll! It never knew where it would end up.

Bramblin loved rolling across the desert. When the wind blew, it rolled over sand dunes, past cactuses and through little towns. Wheee! It met new friends everywhere it went. "Where are you going, Bramblin?" they asked. Bramblin giggled. "Wherever the wind takes me!" And it rolled away, happy and free.

Brambleghast was a big tumbleweed Pokémon that rolled across the land. It was so big that it looked like a giant ball of tangled vines.

Brambleghast rolled through the desert, picking up leaves and twigs as it went. Sometimes it rolled into a town, and the children chased it, laughing. "Catch it! Catch it!" But Brambleghast was too fast. It rolled away on the wind, leaving a trail of leaves behind. The children waved goodbye. "See you next time, Brambleghast!"

Toedscool was a little mushroom Pokémon with long, wiggly legs. It looked like a jellyfish, but it lived on land, in forests and fields.

Toedscool could run very fast on its wiggly legs. Wiggle, wiggle, zoom! It ran through the forest, looking for sunny spots to rest. When it found one, it stopped and stood very still, soaking up the sun. The other Pokémon thought it was just a mushroom. "What a funny mushroom," they said. Then Toedscool wiggled its legs and ran away, giggling.

Toedscruel was a big mushroom Pokémon with lots of long, wiggly arms. It lived in the forest and liked to wander around, slowly and quietly.

Toedscruel gathered in groups with other Toedscruel. They stood together in the forest, very still, like a ring of mushrooms. When the children found them, they thought it was a fairy ring. "Make a wish!" they whispered. Then the mushrooms started to wiggle and walk away! The children squealed with surprise and laughter.

Klawf was a big crab Pokémon that liked to hang upside down from cliffs. It held on with its legs and dangled there, watching the world below.

Klawf liked to hang upside down all day. The world looked so funny from up there! The trees grew down. The sky was at the bottom. "Everything's upside down!" Klawf giggled. When the children walked by, Klawf waved at them with its big claw. The children waved back, tilting their heads to see things the way Klawf did.

Capsakid was a little pepper Pokémon with spicy seeds. It was very cheerful and liked to run around, shaking its leafy head.

Capsakid's seeds were very, very spicy. When it got excited, it shook its head, and its spicy seeds flew everywhere. Achoo! Achoo! Everyone nearby started sneezing! "Capsakid!" they laughed, wiping their noses. Capsakid giggled. It didn't mean to make everyone sneeze. It was just very excited.

Scovillain was a pepper Pokémon with two heads: a green one and a red one. Both heads were very, very spicy!

The green head liked mild, gentle spice. The red head liked hot, fiery spice! Sometimes they argued. "Not too spicy!" said the green head. "Spicier!" said the red head. But when the cooks in the village needed spice for their soup, both heads helped. A little green spice. A little red spice. "Perfect!" said the cooks.

Rellor was a little bug Pokémon that rolled a big ball of mud everywhere it went. It pushed the ball with its feet, rolling it along the ground.

Rellor took very good care of its mud ball. It patted it and smoothed it and kept it nice and round. Pat, pat, roll! "What's inside your ball, Rellor?" asked its friends. Rellor just smiled. It was a secret. It kept rolling its ball across the meadow, very proud of it.

Rabsca was a bug Pokémon that held a big glowing ball above its head with its legs. It used its psychic powers to keep the ball floating and safe.

Rabsca's ball was very precious. It held it carefully, floating it above its head. Inside the ball, something was growing. "What's in there?" asked a little Pokémon. "A little one," said Rabsca gently. "I'm keeping it safe until it's ready." And one day, the ball opened, and a little Rellor popped out. Rabsca was so happy.

Flittle was a tiny bird Pokémon that floated a little bit above the ground. It had psychic powers, and it bobbed around in the air like a little balloon.

Flittle was very curious. It floated up to everything and looked at it. A flower? Bob, bob, look. A stone? Bob, bob, look. A little girl? Bob, bob, look! The little girl giggled. "Hello, Flittle!" Flittle bobbed happily. It liked making new friends.

Espathra was a tall bird Pokémon with colorful feathers around its head, like a fan. When it spread its feathers, they looked like big eyes.

Espathra liked to show off its feathers. It spread them wide and turned around slowly. Ta-da! The children gasped. "So pretty!" Espathra stood very still, letting everyone see. Then it did a little dance, bobbing its head and stomping its feet. The children laughed and danced along.

Tinkatink was a little pink Pokémon that carried a little hammer. It made the hammer itself from scraps of metal it found!

Tinkatink liked to tap, tap, tap on things with its hammer. It fixed broken toys. It fixed wobbly chairs. It fixed a little girl's bicycle bell. Ding! "Thank you, Tinkatink!" she said. Tinkatink smiled and tapped its hammer on its hand. It liked fixing things. It made it feel very useful.

Tinkatuff was a pink Pokémon with a bigger hammer. It was always looking for new metal to make its hammer even better.

Tinkatuff collected bits of metal: old spoons, broken keys and rusty bolts. It tapped them into its hammer, making it stronger. Tap, tap, tap! When its hammer was finished, Tinkatuff showed it to its friends. "Look at my new hammer!" "Wow, it's so shiny!" they said. Tinkatuff swung it proudly.

Tinkaton was a little pink Pokémon with a giant hammer, much bigger than itself! It was very strong and could swing the hammer with ease.

Tinkaton used its giant hammer to help build things. It hammered in fence posts. Bang! It flattened bumpy paths. Bang! It helped build a big new playground. Bang, bang, bang! The children were amazed. "How can you lift such a big hammer?" they asked. Tinkaton giggled. "Practice!" And it swung its hammer again.

Wiglett was a little white Pokémon that lived in the sand on the beach. It poked its head out of the sand to look around, then quickly went back down. Pop! Pop!

Wiglett was very shy. When people walked by, it popped back into the sand. Pop! The children on the beach tried to see it. They waited very still. Then, pop! Wiglett peeked out. "Hello, Wiglett!" they whispered. Wiglett blinked at them. Then, pop! Back into the sand it went, giggling.

Wugtrio was three heads popping up out of the sand together. Three little heads, side by side, all looking around at the same time. Pop, pop, pop!

The three Wugtrio heads liked to play a game. One popped up. Pop! Then another. Pop! Then the third. Pop! Then all three went down at once. Then they popped up in a different order! The children on the beach tried to guess which head would pop up next. "That one!" Pop! "No, that one!" Pop! Everyone laughed.

Bombirdier was a big bird Pokémon with a white apron of feathers. It liked to carry things in its apron and deliver them to its friends.

Bombirdier flew around the town, delivering little gifts. A shiny pebble for a Pawmi. A sweet berry for a Lechonk. A pretty feather for a little girl. Whoosh! It dropped each gift gently, right where it belonged. "Thank you, Bombirdier!" they said. Bombirdier flapped its wings happily. It loved being a delivery bird.

Finizen was a little dolphin Pokémon that loved to play. It liked people and was always happy to swim alongside boats.

Finizen jumped out of the water, flipped in the air and splashed back down. Splash! The people on the boats cheered. "Do it again, Finizen!" So it did, again and again. It loved making people smile. And when the boats sailed home, Finizen swam beside them, jumping and splashing all the way to the harbor.

Palafin was a dolphin Pokémon that became a superhero when its friends needed help! It changed into its Hero Form, with big muscles and a cape.

When Palafin was just playing, it was a cute little dolphin. But when someone was in trouble, it transformed! Flash! Now it was Super Palafin, strong and brave. It helped tired swimmers. It pushed stuck boats free. "Palafin, our hero!" the people cheered. Then it changed back into a cute little dolphin and swam away, smiling.

Varoom was a little Pokémon that looked like a car engine. It made a loud vroom, vroom noise when it was excited.

Varoom loved to make noise. Vroom! Vroom! It revved its engine whenever it was happy. The children in town liked to play race cars with Varoom. "Ready, set, go!" Vroom, vroom! They zoomed around the playground, making engine noises. Varoom always won, because it was the only real engine.

Revavroom was a Pokémon that looked like a car engine, and it loved to race. It could go very fast, and it made a loud vroom when it zoomed by.

Revavroom liked to race around the track. Vroom, vroom, VROOM! It went faster and faster. The crowd cheered. "Revavroom! Revavroom!" When it crossed the finish line, it did a happy spin. Vroom! Then it slowed down and let the little Varoom race too. "Your turn!" it said.

Cyclizar was a lizard Pokémon with a strong body, and people liked to ride on it, like a bicycle! It could run very fast on its back legs.

Long ago, people rode Cyclizar to get around. Zoom! They held on tight as it ran across the fields. The children in town loved riding Cyclizar to school. "Faster, Cyclizar!" they cheered. Cyclizar ran a little faster, its tail swishing behind it. It was the best way to get anywhere.

Orthworm was a long, shiny steel worm Pokémon. It lived underground and dug long tunnels through the earth.

Orthworm could dig through almost anything, even solid rock. It dug tunnels for the little Pokémon to live in. It dug tunnels for water to flow through. Dig, dig, dig! When it came up to the surface, it wiggled its shiny body in the sunshine. Ahh, warm! Then it went back underground to dig some more.

Glimmet was a little crystal Pokémon that looked like a flower made of sparkling gems. It lived in caves, where it glittered in the dark.

Glimmet glowed softly in the dark caves. When explorers came in with their lanterns, Glimmet sparkled like a little star. Twinkle, twinkle! "Look, a crystal flower!" they said. Glimmet blushed and glowed a little brighter. It loved being admired.

Glimmora was a big crystal Pokémon that looked like a beautiful flower made of shining gems. It bloomed in the deep caves, sparkling with light.

When Glimmora opened its crystal petals, the whole cave lit up with colorful light. Pink, purple, blue! The explorers gasped. "It's beautiful!" Glimmora twinkled happily. It liked to bloom when people came to visit, so they could see how beautiful the deep caves could be.

Greavard was a little ghost puppy Pokémon with a candle on its head. It was very friendly and loved to be petted.

Greavard wagged its tail and followed people around. Wag, wag, wag! "Pet me, pet me!" it seemed to say. When people petted it, Greavard's candle glowed brighter. Glow! It was the happiest ghost puppy in the world. And at night, its candle lit up the dark streets, so everyone could find their way home.

Houndstone was a big ghost dog Pokémon that loved to sleep. It slept most of the day, curled up in a cozy spot.

Houndstone was very loyal. Even when it was asleep, it kept one ear open, listening for its friends. When they called its name, it woke up right away. "Houndstone!" Wag, wag! It jumped up and ran to them, its ghostly tail wagging. Then it curled up at their feet and went back to sleep. Zzz.

Flamigo was a pink flamingo Pokémon that always stood on one leg. It lived in big flocks with other Flamigo, and they did everything together.

The Flamigo flock moved together perfectly, like dancers. They all lifted one leg at the same time. They all turned their heads at the same time. They all flapped their wings at the same time. Flap, flap, flap! The children watched and tried to copy them. They stood on one leg and wobbled. "It's harder than it looks!" they laughed.

Cetoddle was a baby whale Pokémon that lived on land, in snowy places. It walked slowly through the snow on its four little legs. Thud, thud, thud.

Cetoddle loved the cold and the snow. It rolled in the snow, slid down snowy hills and made snow angels. Wheee! The children in the snowy village played with Cetoddle all winter long. They built it a snow fort, and Cetoddle sat inside it, very pleased. It was their favorite snowy friend.

Cetitan was a big whale Pokémon that lived in the snowy mountains. It had an ice horn on its head and walked on four strong legs.

Cetitan was big and strong, but it was very gentle. It walked slowly through the snow, making a path for the little Cetoddle to follow. Thud, thud, thud. When they reached the top of the mountain, Cetitan slid down on its belly, and the little ones followed. Wheeee! It was the best sledding ever.

Veluza was a sleek fish Pokémon that swam gracefully through the sea. It was very calm and liked to think quietly while it swam.

Veluza swam slowly, looking at the beautiful coral and the colorful fish. It didn't like to hurry. "The sea is so beautiful," it thought. When the little fish were in a rush, Veluza told them to slow down. "Look around," it said. "See how pretty everything is?" The little fish stopped and looked. And they saw it too.

Dondozo was a giant fish Pokémon, one of the biggest in the sea. It had a big mouth and a big appetite, and it was very easygoing.

Dondozo had a best friend: a tiny dragon named Tatsugiri. Tatsugiri rode in Dondozo's mouth, like a little captain. "Left!" said Tatsugiri. Dondozo swam left. "Right!" said Tatsugiri. Dondozo swam right. They were the best team in the sea, a big fish and a little dragon, swimming everywhere together.

Tatsugiri was a tiny dragon Pokémon that came in three shapes: curly, droopy and stretchy. It was very clever, and it rode inside the mouth of its big friend Dondozo.

Tatsugiri told Dondozo where to go. "Let's go to the coral reef!" And Dondozo swam there. "Let's go find snacks!" And Dondozo found snacks. Tatsugiri was small, but it was smart. Dondozo was big, but it was easygoing. Together, they made the perfect team.

Annihilape was once a Primeape that was always cross. But one day, it learned to hold all of its big feelings inside, calm and still. And it changed into Annihilape, a quiet, ghostly Pokémon.

Annihilape was very calm now. It sat quietly, thinking. When its friends were cross, it said, "Breathe. Let the angry feeling float away." And they breathed together, in and out, until they felt calm. Annihilape had learned how to be calm, and now it helped everyone else learn too.

Clodsire was a big brown Pokémon with a slow, sleepy smile. It lived near rivers and ponds, and it didn't like to hurry. Ever.

Clodsire moved very slowly. Step... step... step. It liked to sit in the muddy water and relax. Ahh. When its friends rushed around, Clodsire just watched them and smiled. "Why are you always in a hurry?" it asked. Its friends stopped and thought about it. Then they sat down in the mud next to Clodsire. Ahh. It was very relaxing.

Farigiraf was a tall Pokémon with a long neck and a big tail. Its tail used to have its own little head, but now the tail had grown into a big, strong jaw that helped protect it.

Farigiraf was very tall, so it could see far away. It helped the little Pokémon find things. "Where's the berry bush?" they asked. Farigiraf stretched its long neck and looked around. "Over there!" It was the best lookout in the whole meadow.

Dudunsparce was a long Pokémon with a drill-shaped tail. It was much longer than a Dunsparce, and it could dig very long tunnels underground.

Dudunsparce dug tunnels that went on and on, twisting and turning under the meadow. It made rooms for napping, rooms for eating and rooms for playing. The little Pokémon loved to explore its tunnels. "Where does this one go?" they asked. Dudunsparce grinned. "Let's find out!"

Kingambit was the leader of the Bisharp and the Pawniard. It wore a big golden helmet shaped like a crown, and it was very wise and very strong.

Kingambit looked after everyone in its group. It made sure they had food. It made sure they had a safe place to sleep. And it taught them to be brave, fair and kind. "A good king," it said, "takes care of everyone." The Pawniard looked up at Kingambit with admiration. Someday, they hoped, they would be just like it.

Great Tusk was an ancient Pokémon that looked like a giant elephant with huge, curved tusks. It came from a time long, long ago.

Great Tusk was big and strong, and it liked to roll into a ball and roll across the land. Rumble, rumble! The ground shook as it rolled by. But Great Tusk was gentle with little Pokémon. It slowed down and let them climb on its back for a ride. "Wheeee!" they shouted, as Great Tusk rolled slowly through the meadow.

Scream Tail was an ancient Pokémon that looked like a big, fluffy pink ball with a long tail. It came from a time long, long ago, and it had a very loud voice!

When Scream Tail sang, everyone heard it. LA LA LA! The birds flew away. The trees shook. The children covered their ears and laughed. "Not so loud, Scream Tail!" Scream Tail giggled and tried again, softer this time. La, la, la. "Much better!" said the children. And they sang together, nice and quietly.

Brute Bonnet was an ancient Pokémon that looked like a giant mushroom. Some people said it came from a time long, long ago, and it lived deep in a big crater, where tall ferns and strange plants grew.

Brute Bonnet liked to stand very still among the ferns, like a big, quiet umbrella. When it rained, the little Pokémon ran under its wide cap to stay dry. Pitter, patter, went the rain. Snug and dry, went the little ones. Brute Bonnet didn't say a word. It just stood there, still and patient, until the sun came out again.

Flutter Mane was an ancient Pokémon with long, flowing hair that floated around it like a scarf in the wind. People said it looked a little like a Misdreavus from long, long ago.

Flutter Mane drifted through the air without making a sound. Swish, swoosh. At night, it hummed soft, sleepy songs as it floated over the treetops. The little Pokémon in their nests listened and yawned. Hmm, hmm, hmm. One by one, they closed their eyes. Flutter Mane smiled and floated away, its long hair trailing behind it like a ribbon.

Slither Wing was an ancient Pokémon with big, fluttery wings, a lot like a Volcarona from long, long ago. But even though it had wings, it didn't fly very much. It liked to walk!

Slither Wing walked along the ground on its strong legs, flapping its big wings to keep its balance. Flap, step, flap, step! The little bug Pokémon followed it in a line. "Why don't you fly?" they asked. Slither Wing thought for a moment. "When you walk," it said, "you can see all the flowers up close." So they all walked together, looking at the flowers.

Sandy Shocks was an ancient Pokémon made of sand. It looked a little like a Magneton from long, long ago, and it had magnets that pulled the sand together, so it never fell apart.

When Sandy Shocks floated across the beach, the sand rose up and swirled around it. Swish, swirl, zap! Tiny bits of iron in the sand stuck to it like sprinkles on a cake. The children watched, amazed. "How does it do that?" Sandy Shocks gave a little buzz. Then it shook itself, and the sand rained down like glitter.

Iron Treads was a Pokémon from the future, a shiny robot that looked a little like a Donphan. People said it came from a time that hadn't happened yet!

Iron Treads could curl up into a wheel and roll across the ground. Whirr, whirr, whirr! It zoomed along the dusty roads, faster than a car. When it reached the end of the road, it uncurled, blinked its glowing lights and turned around. Then off it rolled again, whirr, whirr, whirr. The children watching from the hill cheered every time it zoomed past.

Iron Bundle was a little robot Pokémon from the future. It looked a lot like a Delibird, the Pokémon that delivers presents, but it was shiny and silver and very, very fast.

Iron Bundle zoomed across the water, spraying jets of water behind it like a speedboat. Whoosh! It carried a little bundle in its tail, just like a Delibird. "What's inside, Iron Bundle?" asked the children. Iron Bundle stopped, spun around and opened its bundle. Inside was a snowball! It tossed it high into the air, and the children laughed as it burst into soft, sparkly snow.

Iron Hands was a big robot Pokémon from the future. It looked a little like a Hariyama, and it had two giant metal hands that were very, very strong.

Iron Hands liked to help. When a big tree fell across the road, it picked it up and moved it out of the way. Heave-ho! When a heavy cart got stuck in the mud, it pushed it free. Heave-ho! The children ran up to say thank you. Iron Hands held out one giant hand, and they all gave it a high five. Slap! It was the biggest high five ever.

Iron Jugulis was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Hydreigon. It had three heads, one in the middle and one on each side, and it could fly very high.

Iron Jugulis flew through the sky like a jet, far above the clouds. Whoosh! Its wide wings caught the sunlight and sparkled. When it flew over the town, the children looked up and pointed. "Look, it's Iron Jugulis!" Iron Jugulis did a loop in the sky, just for them. Then it flew away, leaving a trail of puffy white clouds behind it.

Iron Moth was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Volcarona. Its body was made of shiny metal, and its wings glowed with warm, red light.

On cold nights, Iron Moth flew over the village and spread its glowing wings. The air got warm and toasty, like sitting next to a cozy fireplace. Ahh! The people came out of their houses and looked up. "Thank you, Iron Moth!" they called. Iron Moth flapped its wings gently, scattering little sparkles of light. Then it flew away into the night, glowing like a lantern.

Iron Thorns was a big robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Tyranitar. It was very strong and very sturdy, with spikes all along its back.

Iron Thorns liked to help build things. It carried heavy rocks to build walls. It carried tall poles to build bridges. Stomp, stomp, stomp! "We couldn't do it without you, Iron Thorns!" said the workers. At the end of the day, the children came to say goodnight. When they touched its shiny arm, a little bit of static crackled, and their hair stood straight up! Zzzap! Everyone giggled, even Iron Thorns.

Frigibax was a little ice dragon Pokémon with a fin on its back. It lived high in the snowy mountains, and it loved the cold more than anything.

Frigibax liked to slide on the ice. It lay on its belly and pushed off with its little feet. Wheee! It slid all the way across the frozen pond and bumped into a snowbank. Poof! Snow went everywhere. Frigibax popped its head out of the snow, shook itself off and ran back to the other side of the pond. "Again! Again!" It could do this all day.

Arctibax was an ice dragon Pokémon that froze the air around its face into an icy mask. It liked to sneak quietly through the snowy mountains at night.

Arctibax breathed out cold air that turned into a frosty mist. Hooo! Wherever it breathed, the trees turned white and sparkly with frost. In the morning, the children woke up and looked out their windows. "Look! Everything's sparkly!" They knew Arctibax had come by in the night. So they put on their mittens and ran outside to make snowmen in the sparkly snow.

Baxcalibur was a big ice dragon Pokémon with a long, icy fin down its back. It was very strong, and when it roared, snowflakes swirled all around it.

Baxcalibur liked to breathe cold air across the lakes. Hoooo! The water froze into smooth, shiny ice, perfect for skating. All winter long, the children skated on Baxcalibur's lakes. They spun and slid and fell down and laughed. Baxcalibur sat by the shore, watching them. Sometimes it joined in, sliding across the ice on its big belly. Swoosh! Everyone cheered.

Gimmighoul was a little Pokémon that lived inside an old treasure chest. It loved coins more than anything, and it collected them all day long.

Whenever Gimmighoul found a shiny coin on the ground, it picked it up and tucked it into its chest. Clink! It counted its coins every night. One, two, three, four... Sometimes it peeked out of its chest and looked at people with its little eyes. If they put a shiny coin in front of it, Gimmighoul hopped out, grabbed it and hid again. Clink! "Thank you!" it squeaked.

Gholdengo was a Pokémon made of a thousand gold coins! It was shiny and cheerful, and it rode around on a golden board, like a surfer.

Gholdengo surfed through the air on its golden board. Whoosh! The coins on its body jingled. Jingle, jingle! It zoomed over the town, waving at everyone. "Look, Gholdengo!" the children shouted. Gholdengo did a little spin and tossed a few shiny coins up into the air. They sparkled in the sunlight like fireworks. Then they floated back to Gholdengo, and it surfed away, jingling all the way.

Wo-Chien was a slow snail Pokémon with a shell made of old wooden tablets, all covered in crunchy brown leaves. It lived in a quiet, misty forest.

Wo-Chien moved very, very slowly. Inch by inch. As it went, it gathered fallen leaves onto its shell, until it looked like a walking pile of autumn. Crunch, crunch! The little Pokémon loved to jump into its leaves. Whumph! Wo-Chien didn't mind at all. It just kept inching along, carrying all its new friends on its leafy back, through the quiet forest.

Chien-Pao was a sleek white Pokémon that looked a little like a snow leopard. It could freeze the air around it and glide across the ice faster than the wind.

Chien-Pao loved the coldest days of winter. When the lake froze over, it raced across the ice, sliding and spinning. Swish, swoosh, spin! Its paws left swirly patterns behind it, like drawings in the frost. The next morning, the children came to see. "Look, Chien-Pao drew us a picture!" They skated along the swirly lines, following them all the way across the lake.

Ting-Lu was a huge, slow Pokémon that looked a little like a moose. On its head it carried a big, old bowl with spiky points around the rim, like antlers, and its body was made of stripes of earth and rock.

Ting-Lu walked through the mountains one heavy step at a time. Thud... thud... thud. The ground rumbled softly under its feet. The little Pokémon liked to ride on its back all the way up the steep mountain path. "Are we there yet?" they asked. "Not yet," rumbled Ting-Lu. It never hurried. But step by step, it always got them to the top, just in time to watch the sunset.

Chi-Yu was a small fire Pokémon shaped like a little fish made of flames, with two curly green beads for eyes. It was the smallest of four very old, very mysterious Pokémon.

Chi-Yu liked to swim through the warm, glowing lava deep inside the volcano, the way a goldfish swims around a bowl. Swish, swish! When it got bored, it floated up to the top of the volcano to look at the stars. The little fire Pokémon followed it up. They sat together on the warm rocks, glowing softly, and counted shooting stars until they fell asleep.

Roaring Moon was an ancient Pokémon that looked a lot like a Salamence from long, long ago. It had big, wild wings and a loud, rumbly voice.

Roaring Moon loved the night. When the full moon rose, it spread its wings and flew up, up, up into the sky. Whoosh! It flew in big circles around the moon, and then it let out a happy roar. ROAR! The sound echoed across the mountains. Down below, the little Pokémon looked up from their nests. "There goes Roaring Moon," they whispered, "saying goodnight to the moon." And they snuggled down to sleep.

Iron Valiant was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Gardevoir and a little like a Gallade, mixed together. It was graceful and quick, and it moved like a dancer.

Iron Valiant danced across the meadow, spinning and leaping. Twirl, leap, spin! Its flowing white robes swirled around it. The children tried to dance along, but Iron Valiant was too fast. "Slow down, Iron Valiant!" they laughed. So it slowed down and showed them each step, one at a time. Twirl. Leap. Spin. By the end of the day, they were all dancing together.

Koraidon was a legendary Pokémon from long, long ago, a big red lizard with a long tail and an even bigger appetite. It was very friendly, and it loved to give people rides.

When Koraidon's friend climbed on its back, it got ready to go. "Hold on tight!" Zoom! It raced across the fields, bounded up cliffs and splashed through rivers. Its friend laughed the whole way. When they were tired, they stopped for a picnic. Koraidon's favorite food was sandwiches. Munch, munch! It ate one, then two, then three. Then, full and happy, it curled up for a nap.

Miraidon was a legendary Pokémon from the future, a sleek purple lizard that glowed with electric light. It could change its shape to carry its friends wherever they wanted to go.

On land, Miraidon stretched out long and low, like a motorbike. Vroom! In the water, it turned into a little boat. Splash! And when they jumped off a high cliff, it spread out like a glider and floated down gently. Whoosh! Its friend held on tight, laughing. "Where to next, Miraidon?" Miraidon's lights blinked happily. Anywhere at all, as long as they went together.

Walking Wake was an ancient Pokémon that looked a little like a Suicune from long, long ago. It had a big, flowing crest that looked like crashing waves.

Walking Wake could walk right across the water, as if the lake were solid ground. Splish, splash, splish! Wherever it stepped, little ripples spread out in rings. The fish Pokémon poked their heads up to watch. "How do you do that?" they asked. Walking Wake just smiled and kept walking, its wavy crest swishing in the breeze. When it reached the other side, it turned around and walked back again, just for fun.

Iron Leaves was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Virizion. It was green and shiny, with long, glowing horns, and it was very, very fast.

Iron Leaves raced through the grassy fields like the wind. Zoom! The leaves swirled up behind it in big green spirals. Swish, swirl! The little Pokémon chased after the swirling leaves, trying to catch them. "I got one!" "I got two!" When Iron Leaves finally stopped, it looked back at all the happy little Pokémon covered in leaves. Its lights blinked a happy green. Then off it raced again.

Dipplin was really two little Pokémon in one! They lived together inside a big, shiny apple coated in sweet, sticky syrup, like a candy apple at a fair.

The two little friends inside Dipplin did everything together. When one wanted to go for a walk, the other came along. When one wanted a nap, the other yawned too. Wobble, wobble went their apple as they rolled along the orchard path. The bug Pokémon followed close behind, sniffing the sweet smell of syrup. Sniff, sniff! "Mmm," they said. "Dipplin smells like a candy shop!"

Poltchageist was a little Pokémon made of green tea powder, and it lived inside an old tea caddy, a little pot for keeping tea. It liked dark, quiet places, like the back of a cupboard.

Poltchageist was a bit shy. It peeked out of its tea caddy with its little eyes. Peek! When the grandma of the house made tea, Poltchageist watched very closely. Whisk, whisk, whisk! The green tea turned frothy and bright. "One day," thought Poltchageist, "I'll learn to make tea like that." And every night, it practiced, whisking its own little tea leaves around and around.

Sinistcha was a Pokémon made of frothy green tea that lived inside a beautiful tea bowl. It had grown up from a Poltchageist, and now it knew all about tea.

Sinistcha loved to have quiet tea parties. It set out little cups, little sweets and little cushions for its guests. "Please, come in," it said softly. The little Pokémon sat down, very polite. Sinistcha whisked a cup of frothy tea for each guest, slowly and carefully, without spilling a drop. Swirl, swirl. "Mmm," said everyone. "Perfect." Sinistcha's tea bowl glowed with pride. It had practiced for a long, long time.

Okidogi was a big, strong Pokémon that looked a little like a dog, with huge, muscly arms. It wore a chain around its neck like a collar, and it was very proud of how strong it was.

Okidogi exercised every single day. Push-ups! One, two, three! Squats! One, two, three! The little Pokémon in the village liked to watch and copy it. "Like this, Okidogi?" they asked, doing tiny push-ups. Okidogi nodded. "Good! Now ten more!" The little ones flopped down in the grass, giggling. Okidogi laughed a big, booming laugh and did ten more for them.

Munkidori was a quick, clever Pokémon that looked a little like a monkey. It had psychic powers, so it could make things float just by thinking about them.

Munkidori liked to play tricks with its powers. It made apples float down from the trees. It made leaves twirl in the air. Swish, swirl! Once, it made a little girl's hat float right off her head and spin in a circle above her. "Hey!" she laughed, jumping to catch it. Munkidori giggled and floated the hat gently back down onto her head. "Here you go!"
