Fezandipiti was a beautiful bird Pokémon that looked a little like a pheasant, with long, shiny, colorful feathers. It loved to be admired, and it spent a lot of time looking at its reflection in the pond.

One morning, a little Pokémon slipped and fell into a muddy puddle. "Help!" it squeaked. Fezandipiti looked at the mud. Then it looked at its shiny feathers. Then it looked at the little Pokémon. Splash! It waded right in and lifted the little one out. Now they were both covered in mud! The little Pokémon giggled. And Fezandipiti, muddy from beak to tail, giggled too.

Ogerpon was a little Pokémon that lived alone in the mountains, and it had four special masks. When it wore a different mask, it changed its color and its power!

With the green Teal Mask, Ogerpon was leafy and quick. With the blue Wellspring Mask, it was splashy and cool. With the red Hearthflame Mask, it was warm and fiery. And with the gray Cornerstone Mask, it was strong and sturdy, like a rock. The children in the village made masks too, out of paper and paint. They held them up to their faces and danced, pretending to be Ogerpon. Ogerpon peeked out from behind a tree and smiled.

Archaludon was a big, shiny Pokémon made of strong metal. When it got down on all fours and arched its long back, it looked just like a bridge!

One day, the little Pokémon wanted to cross a wide, rushing river, but there was no way across. "What do we do?" they worried. Archaludon walked to the river, planted its feet on both banks and arched its back. Clunk! "Climb on!" it said. One by one, the little Pokémon hurried across its strong metal back. Pitter, patter, pitter. When they reached the other side, they cheered. "Thank you, Archaludon!"

Hydrapple was a big dragon Pokémon that was really seven little dragons, called syrpents, all living together inside an apple made of sweet syrup. The syrpent in the middle had two horns, and it was the leader.

Every morning, the leader called out, "Roll call! Is everyone here?" One by one, the other six popped up their heads. "Here!" "Here!" "Here!" "Here!" "Here!" "Here!" "Six friends," said the leader, "and me makes seven. Let's go!" Then off they went to the orchard, all seven together, moving as one big, happy, sticky Hydrapple.

Gouging Fire was an ancient Pokémon that looked a little like an Entei from long, long ago. It had a huge, shaggy mane of fire that crackled and glowed.

At night, when the air got chilly, Gouging Fire lay down in the middle of the meadow. Its fiery mane glowed like a campfire. Crackle, pop! The little Pokémon came and sat around it in a circle. They toasted berries on sticks until they were warm and sweet. Mmm! Then they lay back and looked at the stars, cozy and full. Gouging Fire watched over them until they all fell asleep.

Raging Bolt was an ancient Pokémon that looked a little like a Raikou from long, long ago. It had a very long neck, like a dinosaur, and its head was wrapped in a fluffy purple mane that looked like a storm cloud.

Some of the little Pokémon were afraid of thunderstorms. Rumble, rumble! "What's that noise?" they squeaked. Raging Bolt lowered its long neck down to them. "That's just me," it rumbled gently, "humming a song." The little ones peeked out. They saw tiny sparks dancing in its cloudy mane, and it wasn't scary at all. It was beautiful. After that, whenever it thundered, they smiled.

Iron Boulder was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Terrakion. It had a sturdy body, strong legs and one tall, shiny horn.

Iron Boulder loved to leap from rock to rock, high up in the mountains. Hop! Hop! Hop! It never slipped, not even once. One day, a little Pokémon got stuck on a high ledge and couldn't get down. Iron Boulder hopped up beside it. "Climb on my back," it said. Then, hop, hop, hop, it carried the little one safely down to the meadow below. "You're amazing!" said the little Pokémon. Iron Boulder's lights blinked proudly.

Iron Crown was a robot Pokémon from the future that looked a little like a Cobalion. On top of its head was something shiny that looked just like a crown.

Iron Crown was calm and wise, and the other Pokémon came to it when they couldn't agree. "It's my turn on the swing!" "No, it's mine!" Iron Crown listened carefully to both sides. Its lights blinked as it thought. Blink, blink. Then it said, "Take turns. Count to twenty, then switch." So they did. One, two, three... And soon everyone had a turn, and everyone was happy.

Terapagos was a little turtle Pokémon that lived deep, deep down in a giant crater. Its shell was covered in colorful crystals that sparkled like a rainbow.

When Terapagos was happy, its crystals glowed brighter and brighter. Twinkle, sparkle, shine! The light bounced all around, painting the cave walls red, blue, green and gold. The little Pokémon who lived in the crater loved to visit. They danced in the colorful light, and their shadows danced too. "Glow some more, Terapagos!" they cheered. And Terapagos glowed and glowed, until the whole crater shone like the inside of a jewel.

Pecharunt was a little purple Pokémon that lived inside a hard shell shaped like a big peach. Its favorite food in the whole world was mochi, soft and chewy rice cakes.

When Pecharunt felt shy, it pulled itself all the way into its peach shell and stayed very still. One day, two little Pokémon found it sitting under a tree. "Look, a giant peach!" they said, and they tried to lift it. Heave, ho! Then the peach blinked. "Eek!" squeaked the little Pokémon. "Eek!" squeaked Pecharunt. Then everyone laughed, and they sat down together for a picnic of mochi.
